````python
        packaged = Path(asset_path(f"themes/{theme_name}"))
        return str(packaged) if packaged.is_file() else None

    def _apply_editor_settings(self, editor: Any, settings: dict) -> None:
        """
        Apply font/wrap/margin/theme settings to ONE editor.

        Split out of _apply_settings() so newly opened tabs (get_editor)
        can receive the same look without duplicating this code.
        """
        from PyQt5.Qsci import QsciScintilla

        from markdown_editor.markdowncustomlexer import MarkdownCustomLexer
        from markdown_editor.markdowneditor import MarkdownEditor
        from python_editor.custompythonlexer import PyCustomLexer
        from python_editor.pythoneditor import PythonEditor

        # THEME-MANAGED STYLING: font family/size and the paper color now
        # come from the theme's editor section (the Settings dialog writes
        # them there — see _write_theme_editor). The lexers apply them to
        # every style themselves; main.py no longer fights the lexer with
        # editor-level font overrides. That fight is exactly why the old
        # code "worked" for Markdown (setFont on ALL styles) but was
        # invisible on Python (setDefaultFont only touched style 0).

        # Paper override from the Settings color picker (QSettings key,
````

````python
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        """Initialize this main component."""
        super().__init__()
        self.update_check_finished.connect(self._show_update_check_result)

        self.ruff_save_mode = self.settings.value("ruff_save_mode", "safe_format", type=str)
        self.update_available.connect(self._show_update_dialog)
        # retirement statement of all the Python workers
        self._retired_editors = set()

        # Detect if running as a bundled exe
        if hasattr(sys, "_MEIPASS"):
            # Running as PyInstaller exe — sys.executable is the editor itself.
            # Try to find a real Python installation on the system.
            import shutil

            found_python = shutil.which("python") or shutil.which("python3")
            if found_python:
                self.python_runner.set_interpreter(found_python)
            else:
                # No Python found — load from settings or let user pick
                saved = self._load_interpreter()
                if saved != sys.executable:
                    self.python_runner.set_interpreter(saved)
                else:

                        "No Python installation found.\n"
                        "Please select your Python interpreter (python.exe).",
                    )
                    self.choose_interpreter()

            self.python_runner.set_interpreter(self._load_interpreter())

        self.encoding_status = StatusItem('UTF-8', self._choose_document_encoding, self)

        self.interpreter_status = StatusItem('Python', self.choose_interpreter, self)
        self.document_status = QLabel(self)

            self.statusBar().addPermanentWidget(item)
        self._status_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._status_timer.timeout.connect(self._refresh_document_status)
        self._status_timer.start(250)
        
        density: str = self.settings.value('layout_density', 'comfortable', type=str)
        self._apply_density(density if density in {'compact', 'comfortable'} else 'comfortable')

        self.breadcrumbs = Breadcrumbs(self)
        self.breadcrumb_bar = QToolBar('Breadcrumbs', self)
        self.breadcrumbs.configure_toolbar(self.breadcrumb_bar)
        self.breadcrumb_bar.addWidget(self.breadcrumbs)
        # Give the path its own row if another top toolbar already exists.
        self.addToolBarBreak(Qt.TopToolBarArea)
        self.addToolBar(Qt.TopToolBarArea, self.breadcrumb_bar)
        self.breadcrumbs.directory_requested.connect(self._reveal_breadcrumb)
        self.breadcrumbs.line_requested.connect(self._jump_breadcrumb)

        self._breadcrumb_timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self._breadcrumb_timer.setInterval(180)
        self._breadcrumb_timer.timeout.connect(self._refresh_breadcrumbs)
        self.tab_view.currentEditorChanged.connect(lambda *args: self._refresh_breadcrumbs())
        # Also catches Save As / rename without rewriting their save lifecycle.
        self._breadcrumb_path_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._breadcrumb_path_timer.timeout.connect(self._refresh_breadcrumbs)
        self._breadcrumb_path_timer.start(500)

        if hasattr(sys, "_MEIPASS"):
            # We're running as a bundled exe
            import os

            home = os.path.expanduser("~")
            self.file_manager.model.setRootPath(home)
            self.file_manager.setRootIndex(self.file_manager.model.index(home))
        # Reopen the tabs from the previous sessions (no-op when
        # the feature is disabled or nothing was saved)
        self._apply_settings(self._load_settings())
        if self._hacker:
            self._set_scanlines_visible(True)
        self._restore_session()

    def init_ui(self):
        self._debounce = QTimer(self)
````

````python
class MarkdownEditor(QsciScintilla):
    """Edit Markdown source and connect authoring and navigation controls."""
    focused = pyqtSignal(object)
    def __init__(self, parent: Any=None, path: Path=None, is_python_file: bool=False) -> None:
        """Initialize this markdowneditor component."""
        super(MarkdownEditor, self).__init__(parent)
        self.path = path
        self._loading_text = False
        self._shutting_down = False
        self.full_path = self.path.absolute() if self.path else None
        self.is_python_file = is_python_file
        # encoding
        self.setUtf8(True)
        # NOTE: no editor-level font anymore — the theme (via the lexer)
        # owns family, size, colors and paper. _apply_theme_editor_style()
        # below pulls the editor-wide look from the lexer after it loads
        # the theme. JetBrains Mono 13 is only the pre-lexer fallback.

        # brace matching
        self.setBraceMatching(QsciScintilla.SloppyBraceMatch)

        # indentation
        self.setIndentationGuides(True)
        self.setTabWidth(2)
````

<a id="topic-19"></a>

## Topic 19: Welcome screen

### 1. Topic explanation

Wrap the existing editor area in a stack with a welcome view. Show recent files, explicit new-document templates and workspace actions only when there are no open tabs. Opening a file switches back to the existing tab area without creating a second editor stack.

**Current implementation:** Added by this chapter.

**Prerequisites:** Topic 06, Topic 12. Keep all preceding cumulative changes.

**Documentation used:**

- [PyQt5 reference](https://www.riverbankcomputing.com/static/Docs/PyQt5/)
- [Python 3.11 JSON](https://docs.python.org/3.11/library/json.html)

### 2. Topic code

#### `main.py` — updated existing module

The complete changed functions/methods are shown below. Keep them in their named existing classes. Imports and other module-level changes are shown at their exact locations in section 3.

**`MainWindow.__init__`**

````python
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        """Initialize this main component."""
        super().__init__()
        self.update_check_finished.connect(self._show_update_check_result)
        self.documents = DocumentStateStore(self)
        self._dirty_editors = DirtyViews(self.documents)
        self.python_runner = PythonRunner(self)
        self.settings = QSettings("CodeEditor", "CodeEditor")
        self._hacker = self.settings.value("theme", "theme.json", type=str) == "hacker.json"
        self._pre_hacker_theme = "theme.json"
        # Load the saved recent files list, default to empty list
        self.recent_files = self.settings.value("recent_files", [], type=list)
        self.ruff_save_mode = self.settings.value("ruff_save_mode", "safe_format", type=str)
        self.update_available.connect(self._show_update_dialog)
        # retirement statement of all the Python workers
        self._retired_editors = set()

        # Detect if running as a bundled exe
        if hasattr(sys, "_MEIPASS"):
            # Running as PyInstaller exe — sys.executable is the editor itself.
            # Try to find a real Python installation on the system.
            import shutil

            found_python = shutil.which("python") or shutil.which("python3")
            if found_python:
                self.python_runner.set_interpreter(found_python)
            else:
                # No Python found — load from settings or let user pick
                saved = self._load_interpreter()
                if saved != sys.executable:
                    self.python_runner.set_interpreter(saved)
                else:
                    # Prompt user to select a Python interpreter
                    QMessageBox.warning(
                        self,
                        "Python Interpreter Required",
                        "No Python installation found.\n"
                        "Please select your Python interpreter (python.exe).",
                    )
                    self.choose_interpreter()
        else:
            # Running from source — sys.executable is the real Python
            self.python_runner.set_interpreter(self._load_interpreter())

        # The initial file-manager root is cwd for source/wheel launches and
        # home for the bundled executable. Ruff must use the same project view.
        initial_folder = Path.home() if hasattr(sys, "_MEIPASS") else Path.cwd()
        self._workspace_root = self._discover_workspace_root(initial_folder)

        self.ruff_lsp_client = RuffLspClient(
            python_executable=self.python_runner.interpreter,
            workspace_root=self._workspace_root,
            parent=self,
        )
        self.ruff_lsp_client.server_error.connect(self._on_ruff_lsp_error)
        self.ruff_lsp_client.start()

        self.console = None  # will be created in set_up_console_dock
        self.terminal = None
        self.python_editor_active = False
        self.current_file = None
        self.md = markdown.Markdown(
            extensions=[
                "extra",
                "codehilite",
                "toc",
                "sane_lists",
                "nl2br",
                "admonition",
                "smarty",
                "meta",
            ]
        )
        self._preview_css = """
           body { font-family: sans-serif; max-width: 800px; margin: 2em auto 0;
                  padding: 0 1em 4em; background:#1e1f22; color:#dcdfe4; }
           h1,h2 { border-bottom:1px solid #444; padding-bottom:.3em; }
           code { background:#1e1f22; padding:2px 5px; border-radius:3px; }
           pre { background:#1e1f22; padding:1em; border-radius:6px; overflow-x:auto; }
           """
        self.init_ui()
        self._welcome_visible = False
        self._welcome_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._welcome_timer.timeout.connect(self._refresh_welcome)
        self._welcome_timer.start(250)
        self._install_minimap()
        self._install_folding()
        self._install_snippets()
        self._install_file_watching()
        self._install_document_tabs()
        self._install_references()
        self._install_problems()
        self._install_command_palette()
        
        self.outline_empty = EmptyState(self.outline_tree, 'No outline entries.\nOpen a document with headings or declarations.')
        self.search_empty = EmptyState(self.search_list_view, 'No search result.\nEnter a query above to search this workspace.')

        
        self.encoding_status = StatusItem('UTF-8', self._choose_document_encoding, self)
        self.eol_status = StatusItem('LF', self._choose_document_eol, self)
        self.indent_status = StatusItem('Spaces: 4', self._choose_document_indent, self)
        self.interpreter_status = StatusItem('Python', self.choose_interpreter, self)
        self.document_status = QLabel(self)
        for item in (self.encoding_status, self.eol_status, self.indent_status, self.interpreter_status, self.document_status):
            self.statusBar().addPermanentWidget(item)
        self._status_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._status_timer.timeout.connect(self._refresh_document_status)
        self._status_timer.start(250)
        
        density: str = self.settings.value('layout_density', 'comfortable', type=str)
        self._apply_density(density if density in {'compact', 'comfortable'} else 'comfortable')

        self.breadcrumbs = Breadcrumbs(self)
        self.breadcrumb_bar = QToolBar('Breadcrumbs', self)
        self.breadcrumbs.configure_toolbar(self.breadcrumb_bar)
        self.breadcrumb_bar.addWidget(self.breadcrumbs)
        # Give the path its own row if another top toolbar already exists.
        self.addToolBarBreak(Qt.TopToolBarArea)
        self.addToolBar(Qt.TopToolBarArea, self.breadcrumb_bar)
        self.breadcrumbs.directory_requested.connect(self._reveal_breadcrumb)
        self.breadcrumbs.line_requested.connect(self._jump_breadcrumb)
        self._breadcrumb_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._breadcrumb_timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self._breadcrumb_timer.setInterval(180)
        self._breadcrumb_timer.timeout.connect(self._refresh_breadcrumbs)
        self.tab_view.currentEditorChanged.connect(lambda *args: self._refresh_breadcrumbs())
        # Also catches Save As / rename without rewriting their save lifecycle.
        self._breadcrumb_path_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._breadcrumb_path_timer.timeout.connect(self._refresh_breadcrumbs)
        self._breadcrumb_path_timer.start(500)

        if hasattr(sys, "_MEIPASS"):
            # We're running as a bundled exe
            import os

            home = os.path.expanduser("~")
            self.file_manager.model.setRootPath(home)
            self.file_manager.setRootIndex(self.file_manager.model.index(home))
        # Reopen the tabs from the previous sessions (no-op when
        # the feature is disabled or nothing was saved)
        self._apply_settings(self._load_settings())
        if self._hacker:
            self._set_scanlines_visible(True)
        self._restore_session()
````

**`MainWindow._refresh_welcome`**

````python
    def _refresh_welcome(self) -> None:
        """Refresh recent lists on transition to an empty workspace, not every tick."""
        empty = not bool(self.tab_view.all_editors())
        if empty and not self._welcome_visible:
            self.welcome_page.refresh(self.recent_files, self.settings.value('recent_projects', [], type=list))
        self._welcome_visible = empty
        self.editor_stack.setCurrentWidget(self.welcome_page if empty else self.tab_view)
````

````python
    def _welcome_template(self, name: Any) -> None:
        """Create one language-correct unsaved draft from the built-in catalog."""
        python, text = TEMPLATES[name]
        previous = self.python_editor_active
        self.python_editor_active = python
        try:
            editor = self.new_file()
        finally:
            self.python_editor_active = previous
        editor.setText(text)
        editor.setModified(True)
        self._on_editor_text_changed(editor)
        self._refresh_welcome()
````

**`MainWindow.open_folder`**

````python
    def open_folder(self, folder: Any=None) -> None:
        """Select a project folder and retarget project-scoped services."""
        new_folder = str(folder) if folder is not None else QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(self, 'Pick A Folder', '')
        if not new_folder:
            return
        if not Path(new_folder).is_dir():
            QMessageBox.warning(self, 'Open folder', 'This folder no longer exists.')
            return

        selected = Path(new_folder).resolve()
        self.file_manager.model.setRootPath(str(selected))
        self.file_manager.setRootIndex(self.file_manager.model.index(str(selected)))
        self.terminal.set_working_directory(selected, restart=True)
        self._refresh_git_state()

        new_workspace = self._discover_workspace_root(selected)
        if new_workspace != self._workspace_root:
            self._restart_ruff(
                python_executable=self.python_runner.interpreter,
                workspace_root=new_workspace,
            )

        recent = self.settings.value('recent_projects', [], type=list)
        recent = [str(selected)] + [p for p in recent if p != str(selected)]
        self.settings.setValue('recent_projects', recent[:10])
        self.statusBar().showMessage(f"Opened {selected}", 2_000)
````

#### `side_bar_widgets/welcome_screen.py` — new module

Read the complete target file below. Section 3 specifies its installation; do not install a second copy.

````python
"""Recent files, recent projects and starter templates on the empty-workspace page."""
from __future__ import annotations
from typing import Any
from pathlib import Path
from PyQt5.QtWidgets import QLabel, QPushButton, QVBoxLayout, QWidget

TEMPLATES = {
    "Python script": (True, '"""Describe this script."""\n\n\ndef main():\n    """Run the script."""\n    print("Hello")\n\n\nif __name__ == "__main__":\n    main()\n'),
    "Markdown note": (False, '# New note\n\n## Notes\n\n'),
    "Markdown README": (False, '# Project name\n\n## Purpose\n\n## Installation\n\n## Usage\n\n'),
}


class Welcome(QWidget):
    """Show recent resources and templates only when every tab group is empty."""

    def __init__(self, recent: Any, open_file: Any, open_folder: Any, parent: Any=None, *, projects: Any=(), create_template: Any=None) -> None:
        """Keep callbacks and regenerate recent-resource buttons when shown."""
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setProperty("designPanel", True)
        self.open_file, self.open_folder = open_file, open_folder
        self.create_template = create_template
        self.layout_ = QVBoxLayout(self)
        self.refresh(recent, projects)

    def _button(self, title: Any, callback: Any, tooltip: str="") -> None:
        """Add one labeled navigation action with a captured immutable destination."""
        button = QPushButton(title, self)
        button.setToolTip(tooltip)
        button.clicked.connect(lambda _checked=False: callback())
        self.layout_.addWidget(button)

    def refresh(self, recent: Any, projects: Any=()) -> None:
        """Rebuild current settings data and show explicit empty-state labels."""
        while self.layout_.count():
            item = self.layout_.takeAt(0)
            if item.widget() is not None:
                item.widget().deleteLater()
        self.layout_.addWidget(QLabel("MarkdownEditor — Welcome"))
        self._button("Open file", self.open_file)
        self._button("Open folder", self.open_folder)
        for title, values, callback in (("Recent files", recent, self.open_file),
                                         ("Recent projects", projects, self.open_folder)):
            self.layout_.addWidget(QLabel(title))
            if not values:
                self.layout_.addWidget(QLabel("No recent entries yet"))
            for entry in list(values)[:10]:
                path = Path(entry)
                self._button(path.name, lambda p=path, fn=callback: fn(p), str(path))
        if self.create_template is not None:
            self.layout_.addWidget(QLabel("Start from a template"))
            for name in TEMPLATES:
                self._button(name, lambda n=name: self.create_template(n))
        self.layout_.addStretch(1)
````

````python
    def _refresh_welcome(self) -> None:
        """Refresh recent lists on transition to an empty workspace, not every tick."""
        empty = not bool(self.tab_view.all_editors())
        if empty and not self._welcome_visible:
            self.welcome_page.refresh(self.recent_files, self.settings.value('recent_projects', [], type=list))
        self._welcome_visible = empty
        self.editor_stack.setCurrentWidget(self.welcome_page if empty else self.tab_view)

    def _welcome_open_file(self, path: Any=None) -> None:
        """Use normal file opening and its existing missing-file handling."""
        if path is None:
            self.open_file()
        else:
            self.open_recent_file(str(path))

    def _welcome_open_folder(self, path: Any=None) -> None:
        """Open a chooser or a recent folder using one project lifecycle."""
        self.open_folder(path)
        self.welcome_page.refresh(self.recent_files, self.settings.value('recent_projects', [], type=list))

    def _welcome_template(self, name: Any) -> None:
        """Create one language-correct unsaved draft from the built-in catalog."""
        python, text = TEMPLATES[name]
        previous = self.python_editor_active
        self.python_editor_active = python
        try:
            editor = self.new_file()
        finally:
            self.python_editor_active = previous
        editor.setText(text)
        editor.setModified(True)
        self._on_editor_text_changed(editor)
        self._refresh_welcome()

    def current_editor(self):
        """Return the editor focused in the active tab group."""
        return self.tab_view.current_editor()
````

````python
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        """Initialize this main component."""
        super().__init__()
        self.update_check_finished.connect(self._show_update_check_result)
        self.documents = DocumentStateStore(self)
        self._dirty_editors = DirtyViews(self.documents)
        self.python_runner = PythonRunner(self)
        self.settings = QSettings("CodeEditor", "CodeEditor")
        self._hacker = self.settings.value("theme", "theme.json", type=str) == "hacker.json"
        self._pre_hacker_theme = "theme.json"
        # Load the saved recent files list, default to empty list
        self.recent_files = self.settings.value("recent_files", [], type=list)
        self.ruff_save_mode = self.settings.value("ruff_save_mode", "safe_format", type=str)
        self.update_available.connect(self._show_update_dialog)
        # retirement statement of all the Python workers
        self._retired_editors = set()

        # Detect if running as a bundled exe
        if hasattr(sys, "_MEIPASS"):
            # Running as PyInstaller exe — sys.executable is the editor itself.
            # Try to find a real Python installation on the system.
            import shutil

            found_python = shutil.which("python") or shutil.which("python3")
            if found_python:
                self.python_runner.set_interpreter(found_python)
            else:
                # No Python found — load from settings or let user pick
                saved = self._load_interpreter()
                if saved != sys.executable:
                    self.python_runner.set_interpreter(saved)
                else:
                    # Prompt user to select a Python interpreter
                    QMessageBox.warning(
                        self,
                        "Python Interpreter Required",
                        "No Python installation found.\n"
                        "Please select your Python interpreter (python.exe).",
                    )
                    self.choose_interpreter()
        else:
            # Running from source — sys.executable is the real Python
            self.python_runner.set_interpreter(self._load_interpreter())

        # The initial file-manager root is cwd for source/wheel launches and
        # home for the bundled executable. Ruff must use the same project view.
        initial_folder = Path.home() if hasattr(sys, "_MEIPASS") else Path.cwd()
        self._workspace_root = self._discover_workspace_root(initial_folder)

        self.ruff_lsp_client = RuffLspClient(
            python_executable=self.python_runner.interpreter,
            workspace_root=self._workspace_root,
            parent=self,
        )
        self.ruff_lsp_client.server_error.connect(self._on_ruff_lsp_error)
        self.ruff_lsp_client.start()

        self.console = None  # will be created in set_up_console_dock
        self.terminal = None
        self.python_editor_active = False
        self.current_file = None
        self.md = markdown.Markdown(
            extensions=[
                "extra",
                "codehilite",
                "toc",
                "sane_lists",
                "nl2br",
                "admonition",
                "smarty",
                "meta",
            ]
        )
        self._preview_css = """
           body { font-family: sans-serif; max-width: 800px; margin: 2em auto 0;
                  padding: 0 1em 4em; background:#1e1f22; color:#dcdfe4; }
           h1,h2 { border-bottom:1px solid #444; padding-bottom:.3em; }
           code { background:#1e1f22; padding:2px 5px; border-radius:3px; }
           pre { background:#1e1f22; padding:1em; border-radius:6px; overflow-x:auto; }
           """
        self.init_ui()
        self._install_minimap()
        self._install_folding()
        self._install_snippets()
        self._install_file_watching()
        self._install_document_tabs()
        self._install_references()
        self._install_problems()
        self._install_command_palette()
        
        self.outline_empty = EmptyState(self.outline_tree, 'No outline entries.\nOpen a document with headings or declarations.')
        self.search_empty = EmptyState(self.search_list_view, 'No search result.\nEnter a query above to search this workspace.')

        
        self.encoding_status = StatusItem('UTF-8', self._choose_document_encoding, self)
        self.eol_status = StatusItem('LF', self._choose_document_eol, self)
        self.indent_status = StatusItem('Spaces: 4', self._choose_document_indent, self)
        self.interpreter_status = StatusItem('Python', self.choose_interpreter, self)
        self.document_status = QLabel(self)
        for item in (self.encoding_status, self.eol_status, self.indent_status, self.interpreter_status, self.document_status):
            self.statusBar().addPermanentWidget(item)
        self._status_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._status_timer.timeout.connect(self._refresh_document_status)
        self._status_timer.start(250)
        
        density: str = self.settings.value('layout_density', 'comfortable', type=str)
        self._apply_density(density if density in {'compact', 'comfortable'} else 'comfortable')

        self.breadcrumbs = Breadcrumbs(self)
        self.breadcrumb_bar = QToolBar('Breadcrumbs', self)
        self.breadcrumbs.configure_toolbar(self.breadcrumb_bar)
        self.breadcrumb_bar.addWidget(self.breadcrumbs)
        # Give the path its own row if another top toolbar already exists.
        self.addToolBarBreak(Qt.TopToolBarArea)
        self.addToolBar(Qt.TopToolBarArea, self.breadcrumb_bar)
        self.breadcrumbs.directory_requested.connect(self._reveal_breadcrumb)
        self.breadcrumbs.line_requested.connect(self._jump_breadcrumb)
        self._breadcrumb_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._breadcrumb_timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self._breadcrumb_timer.setInterval(180)
        self._breadcrumb_timer.timeout.connect(self._refresh_breadcrumbs)
        self.tab_view.currentEditorChanged.connect(lambda *args: self._refresh_breadcrumbs())
        # Also catches Save As / rename without rewriting their save lifecycle.
        self._breadcrumb_path_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._breadcrumb_path_timer.timeout.connect(self._refresh_breadcrumbs)
        self._breadcrumb_path_timer.start(500)

        if hasattr(sys, "_MEIPASS"):
            # We're running as a bundled exe
            import os

            home = os.path.expanduser("~")
            self.file_manager.model.setRootPath(home)
            self.file_manager.setRootIndex(self.file_manager.model.index(home))
        # Reopen the tabs from the previous sessions (no-op when
        # the feature is disabled or nothing was saved)
        self._apply_settings(self._load_settings())
        if self._hacker:
            self._set_scanlines_visible(True)
        self._restore_session()

    def init_ui(self):
        self._debounce = QTimer(self)
````

````python
        self._breadcrumb_timer.timeout.connect(self._refresh_breadcrumbs)
        self.tab_view.currentEditorChanged.connect(lambda *args: self._refresh_breadcrumbs())
        # Also catches Save As / rename without rewriting their save lifecycle.
        self._breadcrumb_path_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._breadcrumb_path_timer.timeout.connect(self._refresh_breadcrumbs)
        self._breadcrumb_path_timer.start(500)

        if hasattr(sys, "_MEIPASS"):
            # We're running as a bundled exe
            import os

            home = os.path.expanduser("~")
            self.file_manager.model.setRootPath(home)
            self.file_manager.setRootIndex(self.file_manager.model.index(home))
        # Reopen the tabs from the previous sessions (no-op when
        # the feature is disabled or nothing was saved)
        self._apply_settings(self._load_settings())
        if self._hacker:
            self._set_scanlines_visible(True)
        self._restore_session()

    def init_ui(self):
        self._debounce = QTimer(self)
````

## Topic 20: Focus mode

### 1. Topic explanation

Focus mode captures the current dock/sidebar visibility before hiding distractions. Leaving focus mode restores that snapshot instead of blindly making every panel visible. Preserve the user’s own layout choices and use the existing application action/shortcut machinery.

**Current implementation:** Added by this chapter.

**Prerequisites:** Topic 19. Keep all preceding cumulative changes.

**Documentation used:**

- [PyQt5 reference](https://www.riverbankcomputing.com/static/Docs/PyQt5/)

### 2. Topic code

#### `code_settings/focus_mode.py` — new module

Read the complete target file below. Section 3 specifies its installation; do not install a second copy.

````python
"""Reversible focus mode with visibility enforcement."""
from __future__ import annotations
from typing import Any
from PyQt5.QtCore import QObject, QEvent
from PyQt5.QtWidgets import QDockWidget, QToolBar

class FocusMode(QObject):
    """Remember explicit hidden state, including central splitter panels."""
    def __init__(self, window: Any) -> None:
        """Initialize this focus mode component."""
        super().__init__(window)
        self.window = window
        self.previous = None

    def toggle(self) -> None:
        """Hide optional surfaces or restore the captured state."""
        if self.previous is None:
            w = self.window
            self.split = w.hs_split.saveState()
            widgets = [w.side_bar, w.side_panel, w.preview, w.menuBar()]
            widgets += w.findChildren(QDockWidget) + w.findChildren(QToolBar)
            self.previous = [(item, not item.isHidden()) for item in widgets]
            for item, _ in self.previous:
                item.installEventFilter(self)
                item.hide()
        else:
            old, self.previous = self.previous, None
            for item, visible in old:
                item.removeEventFilter(self)
                item.setVisible(visible)
            self.window.hs_split.restoreState(self.split)

    def eventFilter(self, watched: Any, event: Any) -> bool:
        """A tab switch must not reopen the preview during focus mode."""
        if self.previous is not None and event.type() == QEvent.Show:
            watched.hide()
        return False
````

````python
    def __init__(self) -> None:

        self._pre_hacker_theme = "theme.json"
        # Load the saved recent files list, default to empty list
        self.recent_files = self.settings.value("recent_files", [], type=list)
        self.ruff_save_mode = self.settings.value("ruff_save_mode", "safe_format", type=str)
        self.update_available.connect(self._show_update_dialog)
        # retirement statement of all the Python workers
        self._retired_editors = set()

        # Detect if running as a bundled exe
        if hasattr(sys, "_MEIPASS"):
            # Running as PyInstaller exe — sys.executable is the editor itself.
            # Try to find a real Python installation on the system.
            import shutil

            found_python = shutil.which("python") or shutil.which("python3")
            if found_python:
                self.python_runner.set_interpreter(found_python)
            else:
                # No Python found — load from settings or let user pick
                saved = self._load_interpreter()
                if saved != sys.executable:
                    self.python_runner.set_interpreter(saved)
                else:
                    # Prompt user to select a Python interpreter
                    QMessageBox.warning(
                        self,
                        "Python Interpreter Required",
                        "No Python installation found.\n"
                        "Please select your Python interpreter (python.exe).",
                    )
                    self.choose_interpreter()
````

````python
        toggle_git_history_action = view_menu.addAction("Toggle Git History")
        toggle_git_history_action.setShortcut("Ctrl+Alt+G")
        toggle_git_history_action.setShortcutContext(Qt.ApplicationShortcut)
        toggle_git_history_action.triggered.connect(self._toggle_git_history)

        settings_action = view_menu.addAction("Settings")
        settings_action.setShortcut("Ctrl+Alt+S")
        settings_action.setShortcutContext(Qt.ApplicationShortcut)
        settings_action.triggered.connect(self.open_settings)

        hacker_action = view_menu.addAction("Hacker-Mode")
        hacker_action.setShortcut("Ctrl+Shift+H")
        hacker_action.setShortcutContext(Qt.ApplicationShortcut)
        hacker_action.setCheckable(True)
        hacker_action.setChecked(self._hacker)
        hacker_action.toggled.connect(self.set_hacker_mode)
        self.hacker_action = hacker_action

        # B1/C7: Power Mode dropdown — master switch plus one toggle per
        # effect. All four states persist in QSettings (power_mode,
        # power_particles, power_shake, power_glow) like ruff_save_mode.
        # The handlers guard on self.power because the menu is built
        # before the controller is created in init_ui().
        power_menu = view_menu.addMenu("Power Mode")

        self.power_mode_action = power_menu.addAction("Enabled")
        self.power_mode_action.setCheckable(True)
        self.power_mode_action.setChecked(self.settings.value("power_mode", True, type=bool))
        self.power_mode_action.setShortcut("Ctrl+Shift+X")
        self.power_mode_action.setShortcutContext(Qt.ApplicationShortcut)
        self.power_mode_action.toggled.connect(self._toggle_power_mode)

        power_menu.addSeparator()

        self.power_particles_action = power_menu.addAction("Particles")
        self.power_particles_action.setCheckable(True)
        self.power_particles_action.setChecked(
            self.settings.value("power_particles", True, type=bool)
        )
        self.power_particles_action.toggled.connect(self._toggle_power_particles)

        self.power_shake_action = power_menu.addAction("Screen Shake")
        self.power_shake_action.setCheckable(True)
        self.power_shake_action.setChecked(self.settings.value("power_shake", True, type=bool))
        self.power_shake_action.toggled.connect(self._toggle_power_shake)

        self.power_glow_action = power_menu.addAction("Combo Glow")
        self.power_glow_action.setCheckable(True)
        self.power_glow_action.setChecked(self.settings.value("power_glow", True, type=bool))
        self.power_glow_action.toggled.connect(self._toggle_power_glow)

        help_menu = menu_bar.addMenu("Help")

        check_updates_action = help_menu.addAction("Check for Updates")
        check_updates_action.triggered.connect(lambda: self.check_for_updates(manual=True))

        # Stable IDs survive translated or renamed menu labels.
        new_file.setObjectName("menu.new_file")
        open_file.setObjectName("menu.open_file")
        open_folder.setObjectName("menu.open_folder")
````

````python
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        """Initialize this main component."""
        super().__init__()
        self.update_check_finished.connect(self._show_update_check_result)
        self.documents = DocumentStateStore(self)
        self._dirty_editors = DirtyViews(self.documents)
        self.python_runner = PythonRunner(self)
        self.settings = QSettings("CodeEditor", "CodeEditor")
        self._hacker = self.settings.value("theme", "theme.json", type=str) == "hacker.json"
        self._pre_hacker_theme = "theme.json"
        # Load the saved recent files list, default to empty list
        self.recent_files = self.settings.value("recent_files", [], type=list)
        self.ruff_save_mode = self.settings.value("ruff_save_mode", "safe_format", type=str)
        self.update_available.connect(self._show_update_dialog)
        # retirement statement of all the Python workers
        self._retired_editors = set()

        # Detect if running as a bundled exe
        if hasattr(sys, "_MEIPASS"):
            # Running as PyInstaller exe — sys.executable is the editor itself.
            # Try to find a real Python installation on the system.
            import shutil

            found_python = shutil.which("python") or shutil.which("python3")
            if found_python:
                self.python_runner.set_interpreter(found_python)
            else:
                # No Python found — load from settings or let user pick
                saved = self._load_interpreter()
                if saved != sys.executable:
                    self.python_runner.set_interpreter(saved)
                else:
                    # Prompt user to select a Python interpreter
                    QMessageBox.warning(
                        self,
                        "Python Interpreter Required",
                        "No Python installation found.\n"
                        "Please select your Python interpreter (python.exe).",
                    )
                    self.choose_interpreter()
        else:
            # Running from source — sys.executable is the real Python
            self.python_runner.set_interpreter(self._load_interpreter())

        # The initial file-manager root is cwd for source/wheel launches and
        # home for the bundled executable. Ruff must use the same project view.
        initial_folder = Path.home() if hasattr(sys, "_MEIPASS") else Path.cwd()
        self._workspace_root = self._discover_workspace_root(initial_folder)

        self.ruff_lsp_client = RuffLspClient(
            python_executable=self.python_runner.interpreter,
            workspace_root=self._workspace_root,
            parent=self,
        )
        self.ruff_lsp_client.server_error.connect(self._on_ruff_lsp_error)
        self.ruff_lsp_client.start()

        self.console = None  # will be created in set_up_console_dock
        self.terminal = None
        self.python_editor_active = False
        self.current_file = None
        self.md = markdown.Markdown(
            extensions=[
                "extra",
                "codehilite",
                "toc",
                "sane_lists",
                "nl2br",
                "admonition",
                "smarty",
                "meta",
            ]
        )
        self._preview_css = """
           body { font-family: sans-serif; max-width: 800px; margin: 2em auto 0;
                  padding: 0 1em 4em; background:#1e1f22; color:#dcdfe4; }
           h1,h2 { border-bottom:1px solid #444; padding-bottom:.3em; }
           code { background:#1e1f22; padding:2px 5px; border-radius:3px; }
           pre { background:#1e1f22; padding:1em; border-radius:6px; overflow-x:auto; }
           """
        self.init_ui()
        self._welcome_visible = False
        self._welcome_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._welcome_timer.timeout.connect(self._refresh_welcome)
        self._welcome_timer.start(250)
        self._install_minimap()
        self._install_folding()
        self._install_snippets()
        self._install_file_watching()
        self._install_document_tabs()
        self._install_references()
        self._install_problems()
        self._install_command_palette()
        
        self.outline_empty = EmptyState(self.outline_tree, 'No outline entries.\nOpen a document with headings or declarations.')
        self.search_empty = EmptyState(self.search_list_view, 'No search result.\nEnter a query above to search this workspace.')

        
        self.encoding_status = StatusItem('UTF-8', self._choose_document_encoding, self)
        self.eol_status = StatusItem('LF', self._choose_document_eol, self)
        self.indent_status = StatusItem('Spaces: 4', self._choose_document_indent, self)
        self.interpreter_status = StatusItem('Python', self.choose_interpreter, self)
        self.document_status = QLabel(self)
        for item in (self.encoding_status, self.eol_status, self.indent_status, self.interpreter_status, self.document_status):
            self.statusBar().addPermanentWidget(item)
        self._status_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._status_timer.timeout.connect(self._refresh_document_status)
        self._status_timer.start(250)
        
        density: str = self.settings.value('layout_density', 'comfortable', type=str)
        self._apply_density(density if density in {'compact', 'comfortable'} else 'comfortable')

        self.breadcrumbs = Breadcrumbs(self)
        self.breadcrumb_bar = QToolBar('Breadcrumbs', self)
        self.breadcrumbs.configure_toolbar(self.breadcrumb_bar)
        self.breadcrumb_bar.addWidget(self.breadcrumbs)
        # Give the path its own row if another top toolbar already exists.
        self.addToolBarBreak(Qt.TopToolBarArea)
        self.addToolBar(Qt.TopToolBarArea, self.breadcrumb_bar)
        self.breadcrumbs.directory_requested.connect(self._reveal_breadcrumb)
        self.breadcrumbs.line_requested.connect(self._jump_breadcrumb)
        self._breadcrumb_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._breadcrumb_timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self._breadcrumb_timer.setInterval(180)
        self._breadcrumb_timer.timeout.connect(self._refresh_breadcrumbs)
        self.tab_view.currentEditorChanged.connect(lambda *args: self._refresh_breadcrumbs())
        # Also catches Save As / rename without rewriting their save lifecycle.
        self._breadcrumb_path_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._breadcrumb_path_timer.timeout.connect(self._refresh_breadcrumbs)
        self._breadcrumb_path_timer.start(500)

        if hasattr(sys, "_MEIPASS"):
            # We're running as a bundled exe
            import os

            home = os.path.expanduser("~")
            self.file_manager.model.setRootPath(home)
            self.file_manager.setRootIndex(self.file_manager.model.index(home))
        # Reopen the tabs from the previous sessions (no-op when
        # the feature is disabled or nothing was saved)
        self._apply_settings(self._load_settings())
        if self._hacker:
            self._set_scanlines_visible(True)
        self._restore_session()

    def init_ui(self):
        self._debounce = QTimer(self)
````

<a id="topic-21"></a>

## Topic 21: Workspace layout presets

### 1. Topic explanation

Persist named layout states with stable dock and toolbar object names. Built-in Python Coding, Markdown Writing and Git Review presets are explicit arrangements; saved user layouts use Qt state and splitter sizes. Restore only known, compatible data rather than interpreting arbitrary settings as code.

**Current implementation:** Added by this chapter.

**Prerequisites:** Topic 20. Keep all preceding cumulative changes.

**Documentation used:**

- [PyQt5 reference](https://www.riverbankcomputing.com/static/Docs/PyQt5/)
- [Python 3.11 JSON](https://docs.python.org/3.11/library/json.html)

### 2. Topic code

#### `main.py` — updated existing module

The complete changed functions/methods are shown below. Keep them in their named existing classes. Imports and other module-level changes are shown at their exact locations in section 3.

````python
        self._status_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._status_timer.timeout.connect(self._refresh_document_status)
        self._status_timer.start(250)
        
        density: str = self.settings.value('layout_density', 'comfortable', type=str)
        self._apply_density(density if density in {'compact', 'comfortable'} else 'comfortable')

        self.breadcrumbs = Breadcrumbs(self)
        self.breadcrumb_bar = QToolBar('Breadcrumbs', self)
        self.breadcrumbs.configure_toolbar(self.breadcrumb_bar)
        self.breadcrumb_bar.addWidget(self.breadcrumbs)
        # Give the path its own row if another top toolbar already exists.
        self.addToolBarBreak(Qt.TopToolBarArea)
        self.addToolBar(Qt.TopToolBarArea, self.breadcrumb_bar)
        self.breadcrumbs.directory_requested.connect(self._reveal_breadcrumb)
        self.breadcrumbs.line_requested.connect(self._jump_breadcrumb)
        self._breadcrumb_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._breadcrumb_timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self._breadcrumb_timer.setInterval(180)
        self._breadcrumb_timer.timeout.connect(self._refresh_breadcrumbs)
        self.tab_view.currentEditorChanged.connect(lambda *args: self._refresh_breadcrumbs())
        # Also catches Save As / rename without rewriting their save lifecycle.
        self._breadcrumb_path_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._breadcrumb_path_timer.timeout.connect(self._refresh_breadcrumbs)
        self._breadcrumb_path_timer.start(500)

        if hasattr(sys, "_MEIPASS"):
            # We're running as a bundled exe
            import os

            home = os.path.expanduser("~")
            self.file_manager.model.setRootPath(home)
            self.file_manager.setRootIndex(self.file_manager.model.index(home))
        # Reopen the tabs from the previous sessions (no-op when
        # the feature is disabled or nothing was saved)
        self._apply_settings(self._load_settings())
        if self._hacker:
            self._set_scanlines_visible(True)
        self._restore_session()
````

**`MainWindow._layout_snapshot`**

````python
    def _layout_snapshot(self) -> dict[Any, Any]:
        """Capture central-widget state separately from QMainWindow dock state."""
        return {'docks': self.saveState(1), 'geometry': self.saveGeometry(),
                'split': self.hs_split.saveState(), 'page': self.side_panel.currentIndex(),
                'side': not self.side_panel.isHidden(), 'bar': not self.side_bar.isHidden(),
                'preview': not self.preview.isHidden()}
````

**`MainWindow._apply_layout_snapshot`**

````python
    def _apply_layout_snapshot(self, value: Any) -> bool:
        """Reject malformed records; the caller handles rollback after Qt failure."""
        if not isinstance(value, dict) or not all(k in value for k in ('docks', 'geometry', 'split', 'page', 'side', 'bar', 'preview')):
            return False
        if not all(isinstance(value[k], QByteArray) for k in ('docks', 'geometry', 'split')):
            return False
        if not isinstance(value['page'], int) or not 0 <= value['page'] < self.side_panel.count():
            return False
        if not (self.restoreGeometry(value['geometry']) and self.restoreState(value['docks'], 1) and self.hs_split.restoreState(value['split'])):
            return False
        self.side_panel.setCurrentIndex(value['page'])
        self.side_panel.setVisible(bool(value['side']))
        self.side_bar.setVisible(bool(value['bar']))
        self.preview.setVisible(bool(value['preview']))
        if value['preview']:
            self.render_preview()
        return True
````

**`MainWindow._save_layout`**

````python
    def _save_layout(self) -> None:
        """Persist a named layout without changing any document or tab group."""
        name, ok = QInputDialog.getText(self, 'Save layout', 'Name:')
        if not ok or not name.strip():
            return
        if getattr(getattr(self, 'focus_mode', None), 'previous', None) is not None:
            QMessageBox.information(self, 'Layout', 'Leave Focus Mode before saving a layout.')
            return
        values = self.settings.value('workspace_layouts_v3', {})
        values = values if isinstance(values, dict) else {}
        values[name.strip()] = self._layout_snapshot()
        self.settings.setValue('workspace_layouts_v3', values)
````

**`MainWindow._choose_layout`**

````python
    def _choose_layout(self) -> None:
        """Choose from user-saved names; built-ins remain separate menu entries."""
        values = self.settings.value('workspace_layouts_v3', {})
        if not isinstance(values, dict) or not values:
            QMessageBox.information(self, 'Layout', 'No saved layouts yet.')
            return
        name, ok = QInputDialog.getItem(self, 'Layout', 'Restore:', sorted(values), 0, False)
        if ok:
            self._restore_layout(name)
````

**`MainWindow._restore_layout`**

````python
    def _restore_layout(self, name: Any) -> None:
        """Restore an override or apply an immediate built-in arrangement."""
        focus = getattr(self, 'focus_mode', None)
        if focus is not None and focus.previous is not None:
            focus.toggle()
        values = self.settings.value('workspace_layouts_v3', {})
        if isinstance(values, dict) and name in values:
            previous = self._layout_snapshot()
            if not self._apply_layout_snapshot(values[name]):
                self._apply_layout_snapshot(previous)
                QMessageBox.warning(self, 'Layout', 'Invalid saved layout; previous arrangement restored.')
            return
        for dock in self.findChildren(QDockWidget):
            dock.hide()
        self.side_bar.show()
        self.side_panel.setVisible(name != 'Markdown Writing')
        self.preview.setVisible(name == 'Markdown Writing')
        if name == 'Python Coding':
            self.side_panel.setCurrentWidget(self.outline_frame)
            self.console_dock.show()
            self.hs_split.setSizes([260, 900, 0])
        elif name == 'Markdown Writing':
            self.hs_split.setSizes([0, 650, 650])
            self.render_preview()
        elif name == 'Git Review':
            self.side_panel.setCurrentWidget(self.file_manager_frame)
            self.hs_split.setSizes([280, 900, 0])
            for dock in self.findChildren(QDockWidget):
                if dock.objectName() == 'GitHistoryDock':
                    dock.show()
````

````python
    def _layout_snapshot(self) -> dict[Any, Any]:
        """Capture central-widget state separately from QMainWindow dock state."""
        return {'docks': self.saveState(1), 'geometry': self.saveGeometry(),
                'split': self.hs_split.saveState(), 'page': self.side_panel.currentIndex(),
                'side': not self.side_panel.isHidden(), 'bar': not self.side_bar.isHidden(),
                'preview': not self.preview.isHidden()}

    def _apply_layout_snapshot(self, value: Any) -> bool:
        """Reject malformed records; the caller handles rollback after Qt failure."""
        if not isinstance(value, dict) or not all(k in value for k in ('docks', 'geometry', 'split', 'page', 'side', 'bar', 'preview')):
            return False
        if not all(isinstance(value[k], QByteArray) for k in ('docks', 'geometry', 'split')):
            return False
        if not isinstance(value['page'], int) or not 0 <= value['page'] < self.side_panel.count():
            return False
        if not (self.restoreGeometry(value['geometry']) and self.restoreState(value['docks'], 1) and self.hs_split.restoreState(value['split'])):
            return False
        self.side_panel.setCurrentIndex(value['page'])
        self.side_panel.setVisible(bool(value['side']))
        self.side_bar.setVisible(bool(value['bar']))
        self.preview.setVisible(bool(value['preview']))
        if value['preview']:
            self.render_preview()
        return True

    def _save_layout(self) -> None:
        """Persist a named layout without changing any document or tab group."""
        name, ok = QInputDialog.getText(self, 'Save layout', 'Name:')
        if not ok or not name.strip():
            return
        if getattr(getattr(self, 'focus_mode', None), 'previous', None) is not None:
            QMessageBox.information(self, 'Layout', 'Leave Focus Mode before saving a layout.')
            return
        values = self.settings.value('workspace_layouts_v3', {})
        values = values if isinstance(values, dict) else {}
        values[name.strip()] = self._layout_snapshot()
        self.settings.setValue('workspace_layouts_v3', values)

    def _choose_layout(self) -> None:
        """Choose from user-saved names; built-ins remain separate menu entries."""
        values = self.settings.value('workspace_layouts_v3', {})
        if not isinstance(values, dict) or not values:
            QMessageBox.information(self, 'Layout', 'No saved layouts yet.')
            return
        name, ok = QInputDialog.getItem(self, 'Layout', 'Restore:', sorted(values), 0, False)
        if ok:
            self._restore_layout(name)

    def _restore_layout(self, name: Any) -> None:
        """Restore an override or apply an immediate built-in arrangement."""
        focus = getattr(self, 'focus_mode', None)
        if focus is not None and focus.previous is not None:
            focus.toggle()
        values = self.settings.value('workspace_layouts_v3', {})
        if isinstance(values, dict) and name in values:
            previous = self._layout_snapshot()
            if not self._apply_layout_snapshot(values[name]):
                self._apply_layout_snapshot(previous)
                QMessageBox.warning(self, 'Layout', 'Invalid saved layout; previous arrangement restored.')
            return
        for dock in self.findChildren(QDockWidget):
            dock.hide()
        self.side_bar.show()
        self.side_panel.setVisible(name != 'Markdown Writing')
        self.preview.setVisible(name == 'Markdown Writing')
        if name == 'Python Coding':
            self.side_panel.setCurrentWidget(self.outline_frame)
            self.console_dock.show()
            self.hs_split.setSizes([260, 900, 0])
        elif name == 'Markdown Writing':
            self.hs_split.setSizes([0, 650, 650])
            self.render_preview()
        elif name == 'Git Review':
            self.side_panel.setCurrentWidget(self.file_manager_frame)
            self.hs_split.setSizes([280, 900, 0])
            for dock in self.findChildren(QDockWidget):
                if dock.objectName() == 'GitHistoryDock':
                    dock.show()

    def current_editor(self):
        """Return the editor focused in the active tab group."""
        return self.tab_view.current_editor()
````

<a id="topic-25"></a>

## Topic 25: Automatic recovery

### 1. Topic explanation

Recovery writes isolated atomic draft snapshots, never the user’s source file. A session lock separates live sessions from recoverable crashed sessions. Capture one snapshot per shared document and share its recovery ID across duplicate views. Remove snapshots only after successful save or an accepted final-view close. Drafts over the documented 32 MB limit produce a visible message.

**Current implementation:** Added by this chapter.

**Prerequisites:** Topic 06, Topic 07. Keep all preceding cumulative changes.

**Documentation used:**

- [Python 3.11 JSON](https://docs.python.org/3.11/library/json.html)
- [Python 3.11 filesystem operations](https://docs.python.org/3.11/library/os.html)

### 2. Topic code

#### `code_inteligence/document_recovery.py` — new module

Read the complete target file below. Section 3 specifies its installation; do not install a second copy.

````python
"""Atomic, isolated recovery snapshots; no source-file writes."""
from __future__ import annotations
from typing import Any
import json
import os
import uuid
from pathlib import Path
from PyQt5.QtCore import QObject, QTimer, QStandardPaths, QLockFile
from PyQt5.QtWidgets import QMessageBox

class RecoveryManager(QObject):
    """Own the session lock and a timer for modified document snapshots."""
    def __init__(self, window: Any) -> None:
        """Initialize this document recovery component."""
        super().__init__(window)
        self.window = window
        self.root = Path(QStandardPaths.writableLocation(QStandardPaths.AppLocalDataLocation)) / 'recovery_v2'
        self.directory = self.root / uuid.uuid4().hex
        self.directory.mkdir(parents=True)
        self.lock = QLockFile(str(self.directory / 'session.lock'))
        self.lock.setStaleLockTime(0)
        if not self.lock.tryLock(0):
            raise OSError('Could not lock recovery session')
        self.last = {}
        self.timer = QTimer(self)
        self.timer.timeout.connect(self.capture)
        self.timer.start(5000)

    def discard(self, editor: Any) -> None:
        """Remove this session's draft only after a confirmed save/close."""
        key = getattr(editor, '_recovery_id', None)
        if key:
            self.last.pop(key, None)
            try:
                (self.directory / (key + '.json')).unlink(missing_ok=True)
            except OSError as error:
                self.window.statusBar().showMessage(str(error), 5000)

    def capture(self) -> None:
        """Use atomic replacement so crashes cannot truncate the last draft."""
        for document in self.window.documents.all():
            editor = document.analysis_owner
            if not editor.isModified():
                self.discard(editor)
                continue
            if not getattr(editor, '_recovery_id', None):
                editor._recovery_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
                for view in document.views:
                    view._recovery_id = editor._recovery_id
            target = self.directory / (editor._recovery_id + '.json')
            temp = target.with_suffix('.tmp')
            payload = {'text': editor.text(), 'path': str(editor.path or ''),
                       'python': bool(editor.is_python_file),
                       'bom': bool(getattr(editor, '_utf8_bom', False)), 'eol': int(editor.eolMode())}
            if self.last.get(editor._recovery_id) == payload:
                continue
            try:
                if len(payload['text'].encode('utf-8')) > 32_000_000:
                    raise OSError('Draft exceeds the 32 MB recovery limit; save it explicitly')
                with temp.open('w', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
                    json.dump(payload, stream, ensure_ascii=False)
                    stream.flush()
                    os.fsync(stream.fileno())
                os.replace(temp, target)
                self.last[editor._recovery_id] = payload
            except OSError as error:
                self.window.statusBar().showMessage('Recovery: ' + str(error), 5000)

    def offer(self) -> None:
        """Recover only unlocked prior sessions into independent new tabs."""
        for folder in self.root.iterdir():
            if not folder.is_dir() or folder == self.directory:
                continue
            lock = QLockFile(str(folder / 'session.lock'))
            lock.setStaleLockTime(0)
            if not lock.tryLock(0):
                continue
            try:
                for path in folder.glob('*.json'):
                    try:
                        if path.stat().st_size > 64_000_000:
                            raise ValueError('Recovery record exceeds 64 MB; retained on disk')
                        item = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
                        if not isinstance(item, dict) or not isinstance(item.get('text'), str):
                            raise ValueError('Invalid draft text')
                        answer = QMessageBox.question(self.window, 'Recover draft',
                            'Recover as a new unsaved tab?\n' + str(item.get('path') or 'Untitled'),
                            QMessageBox.Yes | QMessageBox.No | QMessageBox.Cancel,
                            QMessageBox.Yes)
                        if answer == QMessageBox.Cancel:
                            continue
                        if answer == QMessageBox.Yes:
                            old_mode = self.window.python_editor_active
                            self.window.python_editor_active = bool(item.get('python'))
                            try:
                                editor = self.window.new_file()
                            finally:
                                self.window.python_editor_active = old_mode
                            editor._utf8_bom = bool(item.get('bom', False))
                            eol = item.get('eol')
                            if eol in (editor.EolWindows, editor.EolUnix, editor.EolMac):
                                editor.setEolMode(eol)
                            editor.setText(item['text'])
                            editor.setModified(True)
                            self.window._dirty_editors.add(editor)
                            # Persist the recovered copy before deleting its predecessor.
                            self.capture()
                            if not (self.directory / (editor._recovery_id + '.json')).exists():
                                continue
                        path.unlink()
                    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError) as error:
                        self.window.statusBar().showMessage('Recovery: ' + str(error), 5000)
            finally:
                lock.unlock()

    def finish(self) -> None:
        """Called only once all window-close prompts have succeeded."""
        self.timer.stop()
        for document in self.window.documents.all():
            editor = document.analysis_owner
            self.discard(editor)
        self.lock.unlock()
````

**`MainWindow.close_editor`**

````python
    def close_editor(self, editor: Any) -> bool:
        """Close unpinned views; prompt once only when the final view is dirty."""
        if editor is None or editor not in self.documents.documents:
            return True
        if self.documents.tab(editor).pinned:
            return True
        document = self.documents.document(editor)
        if document.dirty and len(document.views) == 1:
            self.tab_view.focus_editor(editor)
            name = document.path.name if document.path else "Untitled"
            answer = QMessageBox.question(self, "Unsaved Changes", f"Save changes to '{name}'?",
                        QMessageBox.Save | QMessageBox.Discard | QMessageBox.Cancel, QMessageBox.Save)
            if answer == QMessageBox.Cancel:
                return False
            if answer == QMessageBox.Save:
                if not self.save_file():
                    return False
                # Save As may replace all views with another editor class.
                editor = self.current_editor()
        if self.recovery is not None and len(document.views) == 1:
            self.recovery.discard(editor)
        self._detach_document_view(editor, remember=True)
        self.tab_view.remove_editor(editor)
        self._dispose_editor(editor)
        self.render_preview()
        return True
````

**`MainWindow._save_editor_to_path`**

````python
    def _save_editor_to_path(
        self,
        editor: Any,
        path: Path,
        *,
        check_external_change: bool = True,
    ) -> bool:
        """Format and atomically save without losing links or newer disk data."""
        logical_path = Path(path)
        try:
            target = save_target(logical_path)
        except OSError as error:
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Save File", f"Broken symbolic link:\n{error}")
            return False

        if check_external_change and target.exists():
            expected = getattr(editor, "_disk_digest", None)
            try:
                external_bytes = target.read_bytes()
                actual = hashlib.sha256(external_bytes).digest()
            except OSError as error:
                QMessageBox.critical(self, "Save File", str(error))
                return False
            if expected is not None and actual != expected:
                if not self._resolve_external(editor, external_bytes):
                    return False

        original = editor.text()
        try:
            formatted = self._run_ruff_before_save(logical_path, original)
        except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError, RuntimeError) as error:
            reply = QMessageBox.warning(
                self,
                "Ruff on save",
                f"Ruff could not process this file:\n{error}\n\nSave without Ruff?",
                QMessageBox.Save | QMessageBox.Cancel,
                QMessageBox.Save,
            )
            if reply != QMessageBox.Save:
                return False
            formatted = original

        temporary = None
        try:
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            data = self._encode_editor_text(editor, formatted)
            with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
                dir=target.parent,
                prefix=f".{target.name}.",
                delete=False,
            ) as handle:
                temporary = Path(handle.name)
                handle.write(data)
                handle.flush()
                os.fsync(handle.fileno())
            if target.exists():
                os.chmod(temporary, target.stat().st_mode)
            os.replace(temporary, target)
            temporary = None
        except OSError as error:
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Save File", f"Could not save '{logical_path}':\n{error}")
            return False
        finally:
            if temporary is not None:
                temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)

        if formatted != original:
            # Retain the pre-format text as one Undo step after the save.
            self._apply_formatted_text(editor, formatted)
        editor._save_target = target
        editor._disk_digest = hashlib.sha256(data).digest()
        self._retarget_document(editor, logical_path)
        self.mark_editor_clean(editor)
        if self.recovery is not None:
            self.recovery.discard(editor)
        return True
````

**`MainWindow.closeEvent`**

````python
    def closeEvent(self, event: Any) -> Any:
        """Closeevent."""
        if getattr(self, "_close_ready", False):
            event.accept()
            return super().closeEvent(event)

        if not getattr(self, "_close_prompts_complete", False):
            # DirtyViews yields one representative per dirty document.
            for editor in list(self._dirty_editors):
                self.tab_view.focus_editor(editor)
                path = getattr(editor, "path", None)
                name = Path(path).name if path is not None else "Untitled"
                reply = QMessageBox.question(
                    self,
                    "Unsaved Changes",
                    f"Save changes to '{name}'?",
                    QMessageBox.Save | QMessageBox.Discard | QMessageBox.Cancel,
                    QMessageBox.Save,
                )
                if reply == QMessageBox.Cancel:
                    event.ignore()
                    return
                if reply == QMessageBox.Save and not self.save_file():
                    event.ignore()
                    return
            if self.recovery is not None:
                self.recovery.finish()
            self._close_prompts_complete = True
            self.save_session()

        for editor in list(self.tab_view.all_editors()):
            self.tab_view.remove_editor(editor)
            self._dispose_editor(editor)

        self.file_watcher.shutdown()
        self.terminal.stop()
        if hasattr(self.python_runner, "shutdown"):
            self.python_runner.shutdown()
        else:
            # Compatibility until Fix 5 replaces PythonRunner.
            self.python_runner.stop()
        self.ruff_lsp_client.shutdown()
        if hasattr(self.search_worker, "shutdown"):
            self.search_worker.shutdown()
        self.settings.setValue("recent_files", self.recent_files)
        
        self.file_manager.git_checker.shutdown()
        self.git_service.shutdown()

        if self._background_work_running():
            event.ignore()
            QTimer.singleShot(100, self._finish_pending_close)
            return

        self._close_ready = True
        event.accept()
        super().closeEvent(event)
````

````python
        if document.dirty and len(document.views) == 1:
            self.tab_view.focus_editor(editor)
            name = document.path.name if document.path else "Untitled"
            answer = QMessageBox.question(self, "Unsaved Changes", f"Save changes to '{name}'?",
                        QMessageBox.Save | QMessageBox.Discard | QMessageBox.Cancel, QMessageBox.Save)
            if answer == QMessageBox.Cancel:
                return False
            if answer == QMessageBox.Save:
                if not self.save_file():
                    return False
                # Save As may replace all views with another editor class.
                editor = self.current_editor()
        if self.recovery is not None and len(document.views) == 1:
            self.recovery.discard(editor)
        self._detach_document_view(editor, remember=True)
        self.tab_view.remove_editor(editor)
        self._dispose_editor(editor)
        self.render_preview()
        return True
    
    def _dispose_editor(self, editor: Any) -> None:
        """Delete now, or retain a Python editor until its workers finish."""
````

## Topic 28: Compare/diff editor

### 1. Topic explanation

Use one read-only comparison dialog for buffer/disk, two files, local history, Git HEAD and rename previews. SequenceMatcher highlights differing lines and linked scroll bars map positions proportionally without feedback loops. Comparing immutable snapshots does not itself save or modify either file.

**Current implementation:** Added by this chapter.

**Prerequisites:** Topic 12. Keep all preceding cumulative changes.

**Documentation used:**

- [Python 3.11 difflib](https://docs.python.org/3.11/library/difflib.html)
- [Scintilla editing, markers, indicators and folding](https://www.scintilla.org/ScintillaDoc.html)

### 2. Topic code

#### `main.py` — updated existing module

The complete changed functions/methods are shown below. Keep them in their named existing classes. Imports and other module-level changes are shown at their exact locations in section 3.

**`MainWindow._compare_buffer_with_disk`**

````python
    def _compare_buffer_with_disk(self) -> None:
        """Read exact UTF-8 bytes without newline translation."""
        editor = self.current_editor()
        if editor is None or not getattr(editor, 'path', None):
            return
        try:
            disk = Path(editor.path).read_bytes().decode('utf-8-sig')
            ComparisonDialog(editor.text(), disk, 'Buffer / Disk', self, accept_text=None).exec_()
        except (OSError, UnicodeError) as error:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, 'Compare', str(error))
````

**`MainWindow._compare_two_files`**

````python
    def _compare_two_files(self) -> None:
        """Open immutable file snapshots; never replace an open buffer."""
        paths = []
        for label in ('First file', 'Second file'):
            path, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(self, label)
            if not path:
                return
            paths.append(Path(path))
        try:
            left, right = [p.read_bytes().decode('utf-8-sig') for p in paths]
            ComparisonDialog(left, right, f'{paths[0].name} / {paths[1].name}', self, accept_text=None).exec_()
        except (OSError, UnicodeError) as error:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, 'Compare', str(error))
````

**`MainWindow._compare_git_head`**

````python
    def _compare_git_head(self) -> None:
        """Resolve repository root and read HEAD with two nonblocking Git requests."""
        editor = self.current_editor()
        if editor is None or not getattr(editor, 'path', None):
            return
        if getattr(self, '_comparison_process', None) is not None:
            return
        path, source = Path(editor.path).resolve(), editor.text()
        process = QProcess(self)
        self._comparison_process = process
        self._comparison_bytes = bytearray()
        process.setWorkingDirectory(str(path.parent))
        def read() -> None:
            """Drain output while bounding retained Git data."""
            self._comparison_bytes.extend(bytes(process.readAllStandardOutput()))
            if len(self._comparison_bytes) > 16_000_000:
                process.kill()
        def finish(code: Any, status: Any) -> None:
            """Start the blob read only after Git returned a valid root."""
            read()
            if code == 0 and status == QProcess.NormalExit and getattr(process, '_phase', 0) == 0:
                try:
                    root = Path(bytes(self._comparison_bytes).decode('utf-8').strip())
                    relative = path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
                except (ValueError, UnicodeError):
                    code = -1
                else:
                    process._phase = 1
                    self._comparison_bytes.clear()
                    process.setWorkingDirectory(str(root))
                    process.start('git', ['show', 'HEAD:' + relative])
                    return
            data = bytes(self._comparison_bytes)
            self._comparison_process = None
            process.deleteLater()
            if getattr(self, '_close_prompts_complete', False):
                return
            if code != 0 or status != QProcess.NormalExit:
                QMessageBox.warning(self, 'Git compare', 'Git could not read HEAD for this file.')
                return
            try:
                before = data.decode('utf-8-sig')
                ComparisonDialog(before, source, 'Git HEAD / captured buffer', self, accept_text=None).exec_()
            except UnicodeError as error:
                QMessageBox.warning(self, 'Git compare', str(error))
        process.readyReadStandardOutput.connect(read)
        process.finished.connect(finish)
        process.errorOccurred.connect(lambda error: finish(-1, QProcess.CrashExit) if error == QProcess.FailedToStart else None)
        process.start('git', ['rev-parse', '--show-toplevel'])
````

**`MainWindow._background_work_running`**

````python
    def _background_work_running(self) -> bool:
        """Return whether an asynchronous component is still shutting down.

        Returns:
            True while an editor retirement, Git scan, project search, Python
            run, Ruff process, or terminal PTY worker remains active.

        The method is polled by `_finish_pending_close()` through QTimer. It
        must only inspect state and must never block the GUI thread.
        """
        process = getattr(self, '_comparison_process', None)
        if process is not None and process.state() != QProcess.NotRunning:
            return True
        """Return whether an asynchronous component is still shutting down.

        Returns:
            True while an editor retirement, Git scan, project search, Python
            run, Ruff process, or terminal PTY worker remains active.

        The method is polled by `_finish_pending_close()` through QTimer. It
        must only inspect state and must never block the GUI thread.
        """
        if self.file_watcher.is_running():
            return True
        git_worker = getattr(
            getattr(self, "file_manager", None),
            "git_checker",
            None,
        )
        search_worker = getattr(self, "search_worker", None)
        runner = getattr(self, "python_runner", None)
        ruff = getattr(self, "ruff_lsp_client", None)
        terminal = getattr(self, "terminal", None)
        git_service = getattr(self, "git_service", None)
        

        return bool(
            # Retired editors remain here until their workers are disposed.
            self._retired_editors

            # QThread-based background services use isRunning().
            or (git_worker is not None and git_worker.isRunning())
            or (search_worker is not None and search_worker.isRunning())
            or (git_service is not None and git_service.is_running())

            # PythonRunner exposes its own public running-state method.
            or (runner is not None and runner.is_running())

            # Ruff still uses QProcess, so its existing state check remains.
            or (
                ruff is not None
                and ruff.process.state() != QProcess.NotRunning
            )

            # The PTY terminal no longer owns a QProcess. Ask its public API
            # whether the _PtySession worker is still running.
            or (terminal is not None and terminal.is_running())
        )
````

**`MainWindow.closeEvent`**

````python
    def closeEvent(self, event: Any) -> Any:
        """Closeevent."""
        if getattr(self, "_close_ready", False):
            event.accept()
            return super().closeEvent(event)

        if not getattr(self, "_close_prompts_complete", False):
            # DirtyViews yields one representative per dirty document.
            for editor in list(self._dirty_editors):
                self.tab_view.focus_editor(editor)
                path = getattr(editor, "path", None)
                name = Path(path).name if path is not None else "Untitled"
                reply = QMessageBox.question(
                    self,
                    "Unsaved Changes",
                    f"Save changes to '{name}'?",
                    QMessageBox.Save | QMessageBox.Discard | QMessageBox.Cancel,
                    QMessageBox.Save,
                )
                if reply == QMessageBox.Cancel:
                    event.ignore()
                    return
                if reply == QMessageBox.Save and not self.save_file():
                    event.ignore()
                    return
            if self.recovery is not None:
                self.recovery.finish()
            self._close_prompts_complete = True
            self.save_session()

        for editor in list(self.tab_view.all_editors()):
            self.tab_view.remove_editor(editor)
            self._dispose_editor(editor)

        self.file_watcher.shutdown()
        process = getattr(self, '_comparison_process', None)
        if process is not None:
            process.kill()
        self.terminal.stop()
        if hasattr(self.python_runner, "shutdown"):
            self.python_runner.shutdown()
        else:
            # Compatibility until Fix 5 replaces PythonRunner.
            self.python_runner.stop()
        self.ruff_lsp_client.shutdown()
        if hasattr(self.search_worker, "shutdown"):
            self.search_worker.shutdown()
        self.settings.setValue("recent_files", self.recent_files)
        
        self.file_manager.git_checker.shutdown()
        self.git_service.shutdown()

        if self._background_work_running():
            event.ignore()
            QTimer.singleShot(100, self._finish_pending_close)
            return

        self._close_ready = True
        event.accept()
        super().closeEvent(event)
````
