````python
    def keyPressEvent(self, event: QKeyEvent) -> None:
        """Handle editor shortcuts, indentation, and signature scheduling."""
        # Do this before early returns for completion acceptance/indentation.
        if event.key() == Qt.Key_Tab and self.snippets.handle_tab(False):
            return
        if event.key() == Qt.Key_Backtab and self.snippets.handle_tab(True):
            return
        if event.key() == Qt.Key_Escape and self.snippets.active:
            self.snippets.cancel()
            return
        if self.is_python_file and event.key() in (
                Qt.Key_Space, Qt.Key_Return, Qt.Key_Enter, Qt.Key_Escape):
            self._dismiss_signature()

        if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_F12:
            self.goto_definition()
            return

        if (
                event.modifiers() == Qt.KeyboardModifier.ControlModifier
                and event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_Space
                and self.is_python_file
        ):
            line, column = self.getCursorPosition()
            if getattr(self, "large_file_mode", False):
                return
            self._manual_completion_generation = self.auto_completer.get_completions(
                line + 1,
                column,
                self.text(),
            )
            return

        if (
                event.modifiers() == Qt.KeyboardModifier.ControlModifier
                and event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_X
                and not self.hasSelectedText()
        ):
            line, _column = self.getCursorPosition()
            self.setSelection(line, 0, line, self.lineLength(line))
            self.cut()
            return

        if (
                event.key() in (Qt.Key.Key_Return, Qt.Key.Key_Enter)
                and self.SendScintilla(SCI_AUTOCACTIVE)
        ):
            return super().keyPressEvent(event)

        if (
                self.is_python_file
                and event.key() in (Qt.Key.Key_Return, Qt.Key.Key_Enter)
                and event.modifiers() == Qt.KeyboardModifier.NoModifier
                and not self.hasSelectedText()
        ):
            self._handle_python_return()
            return

        if event.text() == "(" and self.is_python_file and not self._shutting_down:
            line, column = self.getCursorPosition()
            before = self.text(line)[:column]
            if self._has_callable_before_parenthesis(before):
                # Let the base handler insert '(' first. The delayed lookup then
                # sees the cursor/source state Jedi expects.
                self._signature_timer.start()

        if handle_pair(self, event):
            return
        return super().keyPressEvent(event)
````

````python
"""Bridge one PythonEditor document to the shared Ruff languafe server."""

from __future__ import annotations
from typing import Any
from PyQt5.QtCore import QPoint
from PyQt5.QtWidgets import QMenu, QMessageBox
from ruff_implementation.workspace_edit import WorkspaceEditApplier, WorkspaceEditError


from pathlib import Path
from uuid import uuid4

from PyQt5.QtCore import QObject, QTimer, pyqtSignal
from PyQt5.QtWidgets import QToolTip

from ruff_implementation.ruff_diagnostics_model import RuffDiagnostic, RuffPosition, RuffSeverity
from ruff_implementation.ruff_diagnostics_view import RuffDiagnosticView

class RuffLspController(QObject):
    """Keep one QScintilla Python document synchronized with Ruff LSP."""
    diagnostics_changed = pyqtSignal(object, list)
    
    def __init__(self, editor, client, parent=None):
        # Parent this controller to the editor unless a different explicit parent was supplied.
        # Destroying the tab then also destroys its controller.
        super().__init__(parent or editor)

        self.editor = editor
        self.client = client
        self._uri = self._uri_for_path(editor.full_path)
        
        # Reuse the existing visual layer. It remains responsible only for QScintilla
        # indicators, marker circles, tooltips and range caching.
        self.view = RuffDiagnosticView(editor)
        
        # LSP versions begin at an integer and must increase for every didChange.
        self.document_version = 1
        
        # didOpen must be sent exactly once per URI/server lifecycle.
        self._opened = False
        self._closed = False
        
        # Full-buffer updates are delayed slightly while a user is typing.
        # This prevents sending one didChange messafe for every individual keypress.
        self.change_timer = QTimer(self)
        self.change_timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self.change_timer.setInterval(180)
        self.change_timer.timeout.connect(self._send_change)
        
        # QScintilla emits textChanged for user input, pasted text, fixes, etc.
        editor.textChanged.connect(self._on_text_changed)
        
        # If Ruff is still starting when this tab is constructed, open_document
        # wil run as soon as initialize/initialized completes.
        client.server_ready.connect(self.open_document)
        client.server_stopped.connect(self._on_server_stopped)

        client.diagnostics_published.connect(self._on_diagnostics_published)
        if client.is_ready:
            self.open_document()
    
    @property
    def uri(self) -> str:
        """Return the stable LSP URI identifying this document to Ruff."""
        return self._uri

    @staticmethod
    def _uri_for_path(path) -> str:
        if path is None:
            path = Path.cwd() / f"untitled-{uuid4().hex}.py"
        return Path(path).resolve().as_uri()

    def _on_server_stopped(self):
        self._opened = False

    def relocate(self, path: Any) -> None:
        """Migrate this open buffer to a new URI after Save As or rename."""
        self._clear_problem_rows()
        old_uri = self._uri
        if self._opened and self.client.is_ready:
            self.client.close_document(old_uri)
        self._uri = self._uri_for_path(path)
        self._opened = False
        self.document_version += 1
        self.open_document()

    def set_client(self, client):
        """Reconnect this document when the selected Ruff interpreter changes."""
        try:
            self.client.server_ready.disconnect(self.open_document)
            self.client.server_stopped.disconnect(self._on_server_stopped)
            self.client.diagnostics_published.disconnect(self._on_diagnostics_published)
        except TypeError:
            pass
        self.client = client
        self._opened = False
        client.server_ready.connect(self.open_document)
        client.server_stopped.connect(self._on_server_stopped)
        client.diagnostics_published.connect(self._on_diagnostics_published)
        if client.is_ready:
            self.open_document()
        
    def open_document(self) -> None:
        """Send didOpen once after the shared server is ready."""
        if getattr(self.editor, "large_file_mode", False):
            return
        """Send didOpen once after the shared server is ready."""
        if self._closed or self._opened or not self.client.is_ready:
            return
        
        self.client.open_document(
            self.uri,
            self.editor.text(),
            self.document_version,
        )
        self._opened = True
        
    def sync_from_editor(self) -> None:
        """Syncronize editor text after programmatic loading with blocked signals."""
        if getattr(self.editor, "large_file_mode", False):
            return
        """Syncronize editor text after programmatic loading with blocked signals."""
        if self._closed:
            return
            
        # setTextSafely() blocks editor.textChanged while loading a disk file.
        # Therefore this method manually creates a new LSP document version for the newly loaded source text.
        self.document_version += 1
        
        if not self._opened:
            # Ruff may still be starting. If it is ready, this sends didOpen with the current loaded text.
            # If it is not ready yet, the existing server_ready -> open_document signal connection will do so later.
            self.open_document()
            return
        
        if not self.client.is_ready:
            return
            
        # The Ruff server already knows this document, but perbiously recieved the empty editor text during 
        # PythonEditor construction. Replace it immediately with the actual source read from disk.
        self.client.change_document(self.uri, self.editor.text(), self.document_version)
    
    def _on_text_changed(self) -> None:
        """Advance document version and schedule one debounced didChange."""
        if getattr(self.editor, "large_file_mode", False):
            return
        """Advance document version and schedule one debounced didChange."""
        self._clear_problem_rows()
        if self._closed:
            return
        
        # Each text state must have a stricly newer version that the last.
        self.document_version += 1
        
        # Normally MainWindow starts Ruff before editors are made. This fallback
        # makes the controller safe if a tab is created during server startup.
        if not self._opened:
            self.open_document()
        
        if self._opened:
            # Calling start() again on s single-shot timer resets its countdown.
            # One change is sent only after typing has been idle for 180 ms.
            self.change_timer.start()

    def _send_change(self) -> None:
        """Transmit the current complete QScintilla text buffer to Ruff."""
        if getattr(self.editor, "large_file_mode", False):
            return
        """Transmit the current complete QScintilla text buffer to Ruff."""
        if self._closed or not self._opened or not self.client.is_ready:
            return

        self.client.change_document(
            self.uri,
            self.editor.text(),
            self.document_version,
        )

    def _lsp_column_to_character(self, line: int, column: int) -> int:
        """Translate negotiated LSP units into QScintilla character columns."""
        if line < 0 or line >= self.editor.lines():
            return 0
        value = self.editor.text(line).rstrip("\r\n")
        column = max(0, int(column))
        encoding = getattr(self.client, "position_encoding", "utf-16")
        if encoding == "utf-8":
            raw = value.encode("utf-8")[:column]
            return len(raw.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore"))
        if encoding == "utf-16":
            raw = value.encode("utf-16-le")[: column * 2]
            return len(raw.decode("utf-16-le", errors="ignore"))
        return min(column, len(value))

    def _on_diagnostics_published(self, uri: str, raw_diagnostics, version):
        """Render only current diagnostics belonging to this document."""
        if self._closed or uri != self.uri:
            return
        if version is not None and version != self.document_version:
            return

        diagnostics = [self._to_diagnostic(raw) for raw in raw_diagnostics]
        self.view.render(diagnostics)
        # MainWindow owns the cat/XP state; the controller only reports data.
        self.diagnostics_changed.emit(self.editor, diagnostics)

    def _to_diagnostic(self, raw: dict) -> RuffDiagnostic:
        """Convert one LSP diagnostic, including negotiated column units."""
        raw_range = raw.get("range") or {}
        start = raw_range.get("start") or {}
        end = raw_range.get("end") or start
        start_line = max(0, int(start.get("line", 0)))
        last_line = max(0, self.editor.lines() - 1)
        start_line = min(start_line, last_line)
        end_line = min(last_line, max(start_line, int(end.get("line", start_line))))

        severity_by_number = {
            1: RuffSeverity.ERROR,
            2: RuffSeverity.WARNING,
            3: RuffSeverity.INFO,
            4: RuffSeverity.INFO,
        }
        code = raw.get("code", "Ruff")
        if not isinstance(code, str):
            code = str(code)

        return RuffDiagnostic(
            code=code,
            message=str(raw.get("message", "Ruff diagnostic")),
            severity=severity_by_number.get(raw.get("severity"), RuffSeverity.WARNING),
            start=RuffPosition(
                start_line,
                self._lsp_column_to_character(start_line, start.get("character", 0)),
            ),
            end=RuffPosition(
                end_line,
                self._lsp_column_to_character(end_line, end.get("character", 0)),
            ),
            revision=self.document_version,
            raw=raw,
        )

    def hover(self, position) -> bool:
        """Show a short diagnostic tooltip for the current line, if any."""
        # SCI_POSITIONFROMPOINT (2022) returns a Scintilla byte position at the
        # mouse coordinate. -1 means the pointer is outside text content.
        byte_position = self.editor.SendScintilla(
            2022,
            position.x(),
            position.y(),
        )
        if byte_position < 0:
            QToolTip.hideText()
            return False

        # Convert byte position to a zero-based line number. UTF-8 decode with
        # errors=ignore handles a pointer position inside a multi-byte character.
        prefix = self.editor.text().encode("utf-8")[:byte_position].decode(
            "utf-8",
            errors="ignore",
        )
        diagnostic = self.view.at_line(prefix.count("\n"))

        if diagnostic:
            QToolTip.showText(
                self.editor.mapToGlobal(position),
                self.view.tooltip(diagnostic),
                self.editor,
            )
            return True

        QToolTip.hideText()
        return False

    def context_menu(self, event: Any, view: Any=None) -> bool | None:
        """Display current Ruff quick fixes without retaining the temporary Qt event."""
        view = view or self.editor
        position = view.SendScintilla(view.SCI_POSITIONFROMPOINT, event.pos().x(), event.pos().y())
        if position < 0:
            return False
        line, _column = self.editor.lineIndexFromPosition(position)
        diagnostic = self.view.at_line(line)
        if diagnostic is None:
            return False
        point = QPoint(event.globalPos())
        def receive(actions: Any, error: Any, uri: Any, revision: Any) -> None:
            """Show returned action titles and apply only the explicitly selected item."""
            if error:
                QMessageBox.warning(self.editor, "Quick fixes", str(error))
                return
            menu = QMenu(self.editor)
            pairs = []
            for action in actions:
                if not isinstance(action, dict):
                    continue
                item = menu.addAction(str(action.get("title", "Quick fix")))
                item.setEnabled(not bool(action.get("disabled")))
                pairs.append((item, action))
            if not pairs:
                menu.addAction("No quick fix available").setEnabled(False)
            chosen = menu.exec_(point)
            for item, action in pairs:
                if chosen is item:
                    try:
                        self.apply_code_action(action, uri, revision)
                    except WorkspaceEditError as error:
                        QMessageBox.warning(self.editor, "Quick fixes", str(error))
                    break
        self.request_quick_fixes(diagnostic, receive)
        return True

    def shutdown(self) -> None:
        """Stop synchronization, tell Ruff the tab is closed, clear visuals."""
        self._clear_problem_rows()
        if self._closed:
            return
        self._closed = True
        self.change_timer.stop()
        # didClose is sent only after didOpen; otherwise the server has never
        # heard about this document and closing it would be meaningless.
        if self._opened:
            self.client.close_document(self.uri)
        try:
            self.client.server_ready.disconnect(self.open_document)
            self.client.server_stopped.disconnect(self._on_server_stopped)
            self.client.diagnostics_published.disconnect(self._on_diagnostics_published)
        except TypeError:
            pass
        self.view.clear()

    def _clear_problem_rows(self) -> None:
        """Remove this URI's Problems rows when its text or lifecycle changes."""
        manager = getattr(self.editor.window(), "diagnostics_manager", None)
        if manager is not None:
            manager.clear_document(self.uri)

    def request_quick_fixes(self, diagnostic: Any, callback: Any) -> None:
        """Request actions with raw provider data and capture the exact document identity."""
        uri, revision, client = self.uri, self.document_version, self.client
        if self._closed or diagnostic.revision != revision or not client.is_ready:
            callback([], {"message": "Diagnostic is stale"}, uri, revision)
            return
        self.change_timer.stop()
        self._send_change()
        def receive(result: Any, error: Any) -> None:
            """Discard replies after closure, relocation, editing or server replacement."""
            if self._closed or client is not self.client or self.uri != uri or self.document_version != revision:
                return
            callback(result if isinstance(result, list) else [], error, uri, revision)
        client.request("textDocument/codeAction", {
            "textDocument": {"uri": uri}, "range": diagnostic.raw["range"],
            "context": {"diagnostics": [diagnostic.raw], "only": ["quickfix"], "triggerKind": 1}}, receive)

    def apply_code_action(self, action: Any, uri: Any, revision: Any) -> None:
        """Apply a direct edit completely or report an unsupported action form."""
        if action.get("disabled") or action.get("command") or not isinstance(action.get("edit"), dict):
            raise WorkspaceEditError("This action needs an unsupported command or resolve step")
        WorkspaceEditApplier(self).apply(action["edit"], uri, revision)

        
        
````

````python
"""A bounded-cost document overview attached to one QScintilla editor."""
from __future__ import annotations
from typing import Any

from PyQt5.QtCore import QEvent, QPoint, QRectF, Qt, QTimer
from PyQt5.QtGui import QColor, QMouseEvent, QPainter, QPen
from PyQt5.QtWidgets import QWidget


SCI_LINESONSCREEN: int = 2370
SCI_SETMARGINRIGHT: int = 2157


class EditorMinimap(QWidget):
    """Paint line-length strokes and navigate the observed editor."""

    def __init__(self, editor: Any, width: int = 96) -> None:
        """Attach resize/scroll/edit signals and initialize one bounded-width navigation overlay."""
        super().__init__(editor)
        self.editor = editor
        self._map_width = max(48, min(width, 220))
        self._line_lengths: list[int] = []
        self._dirty = True
        self._dragging = False
        self._background = QColor("#1e1e1e")
        self._foreground = QColor("#858585")
        self._viewport = QColor(120, 150, 190, 75)

        self.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        self.setFocusPolicy(Qt.NoFocus)
        self.editor.installEventFilter(self)
        self.editor.verticalScrollBar().valueChanged.connect(self.update)

        self._refresh_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._refresh_timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self._refresh_timer.setInterval(180)
        self._refresh_timer.timeout.connect(self._rebuild_cache)
        self.editor.textChanged.connect(self.schedule_refresh)
        self._update_geometry()
        self.schedule_refresh()
        self.show()

    def set_colors(self, background: QColor, foreground: QColor,
                   viewport: QColor) -> None:
        """Apply validated theme-derived colors and repaint."""
        self._background = QColor(background)
        self._foreground = QColor(foreground)
        self._viewport = QColor(viewport)
        self.update()

    def set_map_visible(self, visible: bool) -> None:
        """Show or hide the overview and reserve matching editor space."""
        visible = visible and not getattr(self.editor, "large_file_mode", False)
        self.setVisible(visible)
        reserved = self._map_width if visible else 0
        self.editor.SendScintilla(SCI_SETMARGINRIGHT, 0, reserved)

    def schedule_refresh(self) -> None:
        """Coalesce fast typing into one cache rebuild."""
        self._dirty = True
        if self.isVisible() and not getattr(self.editor, "large_file_mode", False):
            self._refresh_timer.start()

    def eventFilter(self, watched: Any, event: Any) -> bool:
        """Keep the overlay aligned when its editor is resized."""
        if watched is self.editor and event.type() == QEvent.Resize:
            self._update_geometry()
        return super().eventFilter(watched, event)

    def paintEvent(self, _event: Any) -> None:
        """Render at most one representative source stroke per pixel row."""
        painter = QPainter(self)
        painter.fillRect(self.rect(), self._background)
        total = max(1, len(self._line_lengths))
        height = max(1, self.height())
        stride = max(1, (total + height - 1) // height)
        painter.setPen(QPen(self._foreground, 1))

        for start in range(0, total, stride):
            bucket = self._line_lengths[start:start + stride]
            length = max(bucket, default=0)
            y = min(height - 1, int(start * height / total))
            stroke = min(self._map_width - 8, max(1, int(length * 0.7)))
            painter.drawLine(4, y, 4 + stroke, y)

        display_first = max(0, self.editor.firstVisibleLine())
        first = max(0, self.editor.SendScintilla(self.editor.SCI_DOCLINEFROMVISIBLE, display_first))
        display_count = max(1, int(self.editor.SendScintilla(SCI_LINESONSCREEN)))
        last = self.editor.SendScintilla(self.editor.SCI_DOCLINEFROMVISIBLE, display_first + display_count)
        visible = max(1, last - first) if last >= 0 else total - first
        top = first * height / total
        viewport_height = max(2.0, visible * height / total)
        painter.fillRect(QRectF(0, top, self.width(), viewport_height), self._viewport)

    def mousePressEvent(self, event: QMouseEvent) -> None:
        """Begin navigation on a left-button press."""
        if event.button() == Qt.LeftButton:
            self._dragging = True
            self._navigate(event.pos())

    def mouseMoveEvent(self, event: QMouseEvent) -> None:
        """Continuously navigate while the left button remains pressed."""
        if self._dragging:
            self._navigate(event.pos())

    def mouseReleaseEvent(self, event: QMouseEvent) -> None:
        """Finish a minimap drag."""
        if event.button() == Qt.LeftButton:
            self._dragging = False

    def _rebuild_cache(self) -> None:
        """Rebuild one visible snapshot and cap stroke lengths to useful values."""
        if not self.isVisible():
            return
        self._dirty = False
        # Cap measured length because strokes wider than the widget are useless.
        self._line_lengths = [min(120, len(self.editor.text(line).rstrip("\r\n")))
                              for line in range(self.editor.lines())]
        self.update()

    def _navigate(self, point: QPoint) -> None:
        """Map a pointer row to a document line and reveal its corresponding display position."""
        total = max(1, self.editor.lines())
        target = min(total - 1, max(0, int(point.y() * total / max(1, self.height()))))
        visible = max(1, int(self.editor.SendScintilla(SCI_LINESONSCREEN)))
        self.editor.ensureLineVisible(target)
        display = self.editor.SendScintilla(self.editor.SCI_VISIBLEFROMDOCLINE, target)
        self.editor.setFirstVisibleLine(max(0, display - visible // 2))

    def _update_geometry(self) -> None:
        """Position the per-view overlay and reserve its width beside the editor text."""
        self.setGeometry(max(0, self.editor.width() - self._map_width),
                         0, self._map_width, self.editor.height())
        if self.isVisible():
            self.editor.SendScintilla(SCI_SETMARGINRIGHT, 0, self._map_width)

    def showEvent(self, event: Any) -> None:
        """Refresh deferred content when a hidden view becomes visible."""
        if self._dirty:
            self._refresh_timer.start()
        super().showEvent(event)
````

````python
    def recalculate(self) -> None:
        """Compute and publish fold metadata when document text changed."""
        text = self.editor.text()
        digest = hashlib.blake2b(text.encode("utf-8"), digest_size=16).digest()
        if digest == self._last_digest:
            return
        self._last_digest = digest
        model = python_fold_lines(text) if self.language == "python" else markdown_fold_lines(text)
        for line_number in range(self.editor.lines()):
            item = model[line_number] if line_number < len(model) else type(model[0])(0)
            level = SC_FOLDLEVELBASE + item.depth
            if item.header:
                level |= SC_FOLDLEVELHEADERFLAG
            self.editor.SendScintilla(SCI_SETFOLDLEVEL, line_number, level)
````

````python
    def render_preview(self) -> None:
        """Render only sanitized Markdown into the already loaded shell."""
        editor = self.current_editor()

            return
        if not self.preview.isVisible():
````

````python
            editor.setEolMode(QsciScintilla.EolWindows)
        elif cr_count > max(crlf_count, lf_count):
            editor.setEolMode(QsciScintilla.EolMac)
        else:

        self._refresh_document_titles(self.documents.document(editor))
        self.tab_view.set_editor_tooltip(editor, str(path.absolute()))

        self.current_file = path
        self._add_to_recent_files(str(path))
        self._update_outline()
````

````python
        editor.setCaretLineVisible(settings["highlight_line"])

        # Margin 0 is the line-number gutter. Width "0000" fits a
        # 4-digit line count; width 0 collapses it entirely.
        if settings["line_numbers"]:
            editor.setMarginWidth(0, "0000")
        else:
            editor.setMarginWidth(0, 0)

        # Recreate the lexer so a theme switch (or font change written
        # into the theme) takes effect now. A QScintilla can only host
        # ONE lexer at a time; the old one is replaced on the C++ side
        # by setLexer().
        theme_path = self._theme_path(settings.get("theme"))
        if isinstance(editor, MarkdownEditor):
            editor.md_lexer = MarkdownCustomLexer(editor, theme=theme_path, paper=paper)
            editor.setLexer(editor.md_lexer)
            # Re-push the theme's editor-wide look (font, margins, caret,
            # paper). The editor's own method handles the reset-a-lexer-
            # wipes-margin-colors problem in exactly one place.
            editor._apply_theme_editor_style()
        elif isinstance(editor, PythonEditor):
            editor.py_lexer = PyCustomLexer(editor, theme=theme_path, paper=paper)
            editor.setLexer(editor.py_lexer)
            editor._apply_theme_editor_style()

            # QsciAPIs is bound to the lexer instance it was created with,
            # so reattach a fresh one to the new lexer. The AutoCompleter
            # thread repopulates the word list as soon as the user types.
            from PyQt5.Qsci import QsciAPIs

            if getattr(editor, "_api", None) is not None:
                editor._api = QsciAPIs(editor.py_lexer)
                editor.auto_completer.api = editor._api

        # BUGFIX (phantom strings after theme switches): setLexer() does NOT
        # reliably restyle the whole document - old style bytes from the
        # PREVIOUS lexer/theme survive in the buffer, so text typed after
        # switching themes inherits stale styles (everything after the caret
        # rendered as neon-green "strings" until a docstring quote "closed"
        # the phantom string). SCI_COLOURISE (4003) with (0, -1) forces the
        # NEW lexer to restyle the entire document right now.
        editor.SendScintilla(4003, 0, -1)

        if getattr(editor, "large_file_mode", False):
            self._set_large_file_mode(editor, True)
        self._apply_minimap(editor)
        # Reapplying a lexer can replace fold levels even when text is unchanged.
        editor.folding_controller._last_digest = b""
        editor.folding_controller.schedule()
        # Apply explicit overrides after the theme has supplied its defaults.
        apply_preferences(editor, settings)
````

````python
    def _set_large_file_mode(self, editor: Any, enabled: Any) -> None:
        """Suspend optional work while retaining the lexer for restoration."""
        editor.large_file_mode = bool(enabled)
        if hasattr(editor, "folding_controller"):
            editor.folding_controller._timer.stop()
        if hasattr(editor, "minimap"):
            editor.minimap._refresh_timer.stop()
            self._apply_minimap(editor)
        if enabled:
            if editor.lexer() is not None:
                editor._large_saved_lexer = editor.lexer()
                editor.setLexer(None)
            for name in ('_autocomplete_timer', '_ruff_hover_timer', '_signature_timer'):
                timer = getattr(editor, name, None)
                if timer is not None:
                    timer.stop()
            for worker_name in ('auto_completer', 'definition_finder', 'hover_helper', 'signature_helper'):
                worker = getattr(editor, worker_name, None)
                if worker is not None:
                    worker.invalidate()
            editor.SendScintilla(QsciScintilla.SCI_AUTOCCANCEL)
            controller = getattr(editor, 'ruff_lsp', None)
            if controller is not None:
                controller.change_timer.stop()
        else:
            if hasattr(editor, "folding_controller"):
                editor.folding_controller.schedule()
            lexer = getattr(editor, '_large_saved_lexer', None)
            if lexer is not None:
                editor.setLexer(lexer)
                editor.recolor()
            controller = getattr(editor, 'ruff_lsp', None)
            if controller is not None:
                if not getattr(controller, '_opened', False):
                    controller.open_document()
                else:
                    controller._on_text_changed()
        self.statusBar().showMessage('Large-file mode ' + ('enabled' if enabled else 'disabled'), 4000)

    def _toggle_large_file_mode(self) -> None:
        """Allow an explicit override for the active document."""
        editor = self.current_editor()
        if editor is not None:
            editor._large_file_override = getattr(editor, 'large_file_mode', False)
            self._set_large_file_mode(editor, not editor._large_file_override)
            self._preview_fingerprint = None
            if isinstance(editor, MarkdownEditor) and not editor.large_file_mode:
                self.preview.show()
            self._update_outline()
            self.render_preview()

    def current_editor(self):
        """Return the editor focused in the active tab group."""
        return self.tab_view.current_editor()
````

````python
    def _on_editor_text_changed(self, editor: Any) -> None:
        """Mark the specific editor that emitted textChanged as dirty."""
        if editor is None:
            return
        if getattr(editor, "_loading_text", False):
            return
        if not getattr(editor, '_large_file_override', False):
            large = editor.length() >= 2_000_000 or editor.lines() >= 50_000
            if large != getattr(editor, 'large_file_mode', False):
                self._set_large_file_mode(editor, large)
        self._dirty_editors.add(editor)
        # DirtyViews emits stateChanged, which refreshes every view title.
        if editor is self.current_editor():
            self.update_word_count()
            if isinstance(editor, MarkdownEditor):
                self._debounce.start()
````

````python
    def keyPressEvent(self, event: QKeyEvent) -> None:
        """Handle editor shortcuts, indentation, and signature scheduling."""
        # Do this before early returns for completion acceptance/indentation.
        if event.key() == Qt.Key_Tab and self.snippets.handle_tab(False):
            return
        if event.key() == Qt.Key_Backtab and self.snippets.handle_tab(True):
            return
        if event.key() == Qt.Key_Escape and self.snippets.active:
            self.snippets.cancel()
            return
        if self.is_python_file and event.key() in (
                Qt.Key_Space, Qt.Key_Return, Qt.Key_Enter, Qt.Key_Escape):
            self._dismiss_signature()

        if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_F12:
            self.goto_definition()
            return

        if (
                event.modifiers() == Qt.KeyboardModifier.ControlModifier
                and event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_Space
                and self.is_python_file
        ):
            line, column = self.getCursorPosition()
            self._manual_completion_generation = self.auto_completer.get_completions(
                line + 1,
                column,
                self.text(),
            )
            return

        if (
                event.modifiers() == Qt.KeyboardModifier.ControlModifier
                and event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_X
                and not self.hasSelectedText()
        ):
            line, _column = self.getCursorPosition()
            self.setSelection(line, 0, line, self.lineLength(line))
            self.cut()
            return

        if (
                event.key() in (Qt.Key.Key_Return, Qt.Key.Key_Enter)
                and self.SendScintilla(SCI_AUTOCACTIVE)
        ):
            return super().keyPressEvent(event)

        if (
                self.is_python_file
                and event.key() in (Qt.Key.Key_Return, Qt.Key.Key_Enter)
                and event.modifiers() == Qt.KeyboardModifier.NoModifier
                and not self.hasSelectedText()
        ):
            self._handle_python_return()
            return

        if event.text() == "(" and self.is_python_file and not self._shutting_down:
            line, column = self.getCursorPosition()
            before = self.text(line)[:column]
            if self._has_callable_before_parenthesis(before):
                # Let the base handler insert '(' first. The delayed lookup then
                # sees the cursor/source state Jedi expects.
                self._signature_timer.start()

        if handle_pair(self, event):
            return
        return super().keyPressEvent(event)
    
    def _dismiss_signature(self):
        """Cancel scheduled annd in-flight signature help and hide its tooltip."""
````

````python
        if event.key() == Qt.Key_Escape and self.snippets.active:
            self.snippets.cancel()
            return
        if self.is_python_file and event.key() in (
                Qt.Key_Space, Qt.Key_Return, Qt.Key_Enter, Qt.Key_Escape):
            self._dismiss_signature()

        if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_F12:
            self.goto_definition()
            return

        if (
                event.modifiers() == Qt.KeyboardModifier.ControlModifier
                and event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_Space
                and self.is_python_file
        ):
            line, column = self.getCursorPosition()
            if getattr(self, "large_file_mode", False):
                return
            self._manual_completion_generation = self.auto_completer.get_completions(
                line + 1,
                column,
                self.text(),
            )
            return

        if (
                event.modifiers() == Qt.KeyboardModifier.ControlModifier
                and event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_X
                and not self.hasSelectedText()
        ):
            line, _column = self.getCursorPosition()
            self.setSelection(line, 0, line, self.lineLength(line))
            self.cut()
            return

        if (
                event.key() in (Qt.Key.Key_Return, Qt.Key.Key_Enter)
                and self.SendScintilla(SCI_AUTOCACTIVE)
        ):
            return super().keyPressEvent(event)

        if (
                self.is_python_file
                and event.key() in (Qt.Key.Key_Return, Qt.Key.Key_Enter)
                and event.modifiers() == Qt.KeyboardModifier.NoModifier
                and not self.hasSelectedText()
        ):
            self._handle_python_return()
            return

        if event.text() == "(" and self.is_python_file and not self._shutting_down:
            line, column = self.getCursorPosition()
            before = self.text(line)[:column]
            if self._has_callable_before_parenthesis(before):
                # Let the base handler insert '(' first. The delayed lookup then
                # sees the cursor/source state Jedi expects.
                self._signature_timer.start()

        if handle_pair(self, event):
            return
        return super().keyPressEvent(event)
    
    def _dismiss_signature(self):
        """Cancel scheduled annd in-flight signature help and hide its tooltip."""
````

## Topic 40: Shared analysis scheduling

### 1. Topic explanation

Serialize Jedi requests in an application-owned queue. Each request captures document identity, source digest, caret, workspace and interpreter. Keep only the newest pending request per lane; late running results are rejected by a serial number. No Jedi objects or editor widgets escape into result data. All in-process Jedi providers, including references, use this queue.

**Current implementation:** Added by this chapter.

**Prerequisites:** Topic 05, Topic 39. Keep all preceding cumulative changes.

**Documentation used:**

- [Jedi 0.19.2 public API](https://jedi.readthedocs.io/en/v0.19.2/docs/api.html)
- [Python 3.11 concurrent futures](https://docs.python.org/3.11/library/concurrent.futures.html)

### 2. Topic code

````python
"""Immutable Jedi requests and adapters preserving existing editor signals."""
from __future__ import annotations
from typing import Any
from hashlib import sha256
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import uuid
from PyQt5.QtCore import QObject, pyqtSignal
from code_inteligence.analysis_key import RequestKey
from code_inteligence.analysis_scheduler import shared_analysis


def evaluate(key: RequestKey, source: str) -> Any:
    """Run in the worker, returning plain data without live Jedi or Qt objects.

    Script, Name and Signature objects remain inside this function. The selected
    interpreter and workspace determine imports and reference-search scope.
    """
    import jedi
    jedi.settings.fast_parser = True
    environment = jedi.create_environment(key.interpreter, safe=False)
    project = jedi.Project(key.workspace, environment_path=key.interpreter)
    script = jedi.Script(code=source, path=key.path or None,
                         environment=environment, project=project)
    if key.kind == "completion":
        return tuple(item.name for item in script.complete(key.line, key.column))
    if key.kind == "signature":
        results = script.get_signatures(key.line, key.column)
        if not results:
            return ""
        result = results[0]
        return f"{result.name}({', '.join(p.to_string() for p in result.params)})\n{result.docstring(raw=True)}".rstrip()
    if key.kind == "documentation":
        results = script.help(key.line, key.column)
        if not results:
            return ""
        result = results[0]
        return f"{result.name}\n({result.type})\n{result.docstring()}"
    if key.kind == "definition":
        results = script.goto(key.line, key.column, follow_imports=True)
        return next(((str(n.module_path), n.line, n.column) for n in results
                     if n.module_path is not None and n.line is not None), None)
    if key.kind == "references":
        return tuple((str(n.module_path), n.line - 1, n.column, n.name)
                     for n in script.get_references(key.line, key.column, include_builtins=False)
                     if n.module_path is not None and n.line is not None)
    raise ValueError(f"Unknown analysis kind: {key.kind}")


class AnalysisProvider(QObject):
    """Preserve generation-based APIs while sharing one application worker."""
    finished = pyqtSignal()

    def __init__(self, kind: str, editor: Any=None) -> None:
        """Own GUI state only; application ownership keeps background jobs alive."""
        super().__init__(editor)
        self.kind, self.editor = kind, editor
        self.identity = str(uuid.uuid4())
        self.queue = shared_analysis()
        self.queue.ready.connect(self._receive)
        self._generation, self._key, self._shutting_down = 0, None, False
        self.file_path = None

    @property
    def generation(self) -> Any:
        """Return the revision accepted by existing editor result slots."""
        return self._generation

    def context(self) -> Any:
        """Read live workspace and interpreter values on the GUI thread."""
        window = self.editor.window() if self.editor is not None else None
        runner = getattr(window, "python_runner", None)
        interpreter = getattr(runner, "interpreter", sys.executable)
        root = Path(getattr(window, "_workspace_root", Path.cwd())).resolve()
        return str(interpreter), str(root)

    def request(self, line: Any, column: Any, source: Any, path: Any=None) -> Any:
        """Capture text/caret/environment while honoring large-file policy."""
        if self._shutting_down:
            return None
        self.invalidate()
        if self.editor is not None and (getattr(self.editor, 'large_file_mode', False) or self.editor.length() >= 2_000_000):
            if not getattr(self.editor, '_large_file_override', False):
                return self._generation
        lines = source.splitlines() or [""]
        line = max(1, min(line, len(lines)))
        column = max(0, min(column, len(lines[line - 1])))
        interpreter, workspace = self.context()
        editor_path = getattr(self.editor, "path", None) if self.editor is not None else None
        path = str(editor_path or path or self.file_path or "")
        # A content digest and caret are needed: same-revision carets can differ.
        key = RequestKey(path, 0, interpreter, workspace, self.kind,
                         self.identity, line, column, sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest())
        self._key = key
        self.queue.submit(key, lambda: evaluate(key, source))
        return self._generation

    def _receive(self, key: Any, value: Any) -> None:
        """Check text, path and environment again before publishing results."""
        if self._shutting_down or key != self._key:
            return
        if self.context() != (key.interpreter, key.workspace):
            self.invalidate()
            return
        if self.editor is not None:
            if sha256(self.editor.text().encode()).hexdigest() != key.source_hash:
                self.invalidate()
                return
            if str(getattr(self.editor, "path", None) or "") != key.path:
                self.invalidate()
                return
        self._key = None
        self.deliver(self._generation, value)
        self.finished.emit()

    def deliver(self, generation: Any, value: Any) -> None:
        """Require each adapter to translate plain results to its public signals."""
        raise NotImplementedError

    def invalidate(self) -> None:
        """Cancel queued work and reject any running result from this provider."""
        self._generation += 1
        self._key = None
        self.queue.cancel(self.identity, self.kind)

    def isRunning(self) -> Any:
        """Report delivery state for the existing asynchronous editor close path."""
        return self._key is not None

    def shutdown(self) -> None:
        """Detach the editor while immutable jobs remain queue-owned."""
        self._shutting_down = True
        self.invalidate()
        self.finished.emit()
````

#### `code_inteligence/analysis_scheduler.py` — new module

Read the complete target file below. Section 3 specifies its installation; do not install a second copy.

````python
"""One application-owned worker queue for all Jedi providers and workspace scans."""
from __future__ import annotations
from typing import Any
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, Future
from time import perf_counter
from PyQt5.QtCore import QCoreApplication, QObject, Qt, pyqtSignal
from code_inteligence.analysis_key import RequestKey


class AnalysisQueue(QObject):
    """Serialize immutable jobs; publish current results on the GUI thread.

    A lane is a (document identity, request kind) pair. The queue owns running
    jobs after tabs close. Worker closures must never capture an editor widget.
    """
    ready = pyqtSignal(object, object)
    measured = pyqtSignal(str, float)
    idle = pyqtSignal()
    _deliver = pyqtSignal(object, object, int, float)

    def __init__(self, parent: Any=None) -> None:
        """Create one worker because Jedi's fast parser is not thread-safe."""
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.pool = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1, thread_name_prefix="editor-analysis")
        self.latest, self.pending_by_kind = {}, {}
        self.futures = set()
        self._serial, self._closing = 0, False
        self._deliver.connect(self._receive, Qt.QueuedConnection)

    def submit(self, key: RequestKey, work: Any) -> None:
        """Replace pending work in one lane and reuse exact immutable results."""
        if self._closing:
            return
        lane = (key.document, key.kind)
        self._serial += 1
        serial = self._serial
        self.latest[lane] = (key, serial)
        previous = self.pending_by_kind.pop(lane, None)
        if previous is not None:
            previous.cancel()
        started = perf_counter()
        future = self.pool.submit(work)
        self.futures.add(future)
        self.pending_by_kind[lane] = future
        # Queue delivery even when the job completes before callback registration.
        future.add_done_callback(lambda done: self._deliver.emit(
            key, done, serial, perf_counter() - started))

    def _receive(self, key: Any, future: Any, serial: Any, elapsed: Any) -> None:
        """Drain futures and reject stale serials even when keys are identical."""
        self.futures.discard(future)
        lane = (key.document, key.kind)
        if self.pending_by_kind.get(lane) is future:
            self.pending_by_kind.pop(lane, None)
        self.measured.emit(key.kind, elapsed)
        if not self._closing and self.latest.get(lane) == (key, serial):
            try:
                value = future.result()
            except Exception as error:
                value = error
            self.ready.emit(key, value)
        if not self.futures:
            self.idle.emit()

    def cancel(self, document: str, kind: str | None = None) -> None:
        """Invalidate one provider or all providers belonging to a document."""
        for lane in list(self.latest):
            if lane[0] == document and (kind is None or lane[1] == kind):
                self.latest.pop(lane, None)
                future = self.pending_by_kind.pop(lane, None)
                if future is not None:
                    future.cancel()

    def invalidate_all(self) -> None:
        """Reject old environment results on workspace or interpreter changes."""
        self.latest.clear()
        for future in self.pending_by_kind.values():
            future.cancel()
        self.pending_by_kind.clear()

    def shutdown(self) -> None:
        """Stop submissions without blocking the GUI on running Python work."""
        if self._closing:
            return
        self._closing = True
        self.invalidate_all()
        self.pool.shutdown(wait=False, cancel_futures=True)

    def is_running(self) -> bool:
        """Keep application ownership until queued deliveries have drained."""
        return bool(self.futures)


def shared_analysis() -> AnalysisQueue:
    """Return the single analysis queue owned by the current QApplication."""
    app = QCoreApplication.instance()
    if app is None:
        raise RuntimeError("Create QApplication before analysis providers")
    queue = getattr(app, "_markdown_analysis_queue", None)
    if queue is None or queue._closing:
        queue = AnalysisQueue(app)
        app._markdown_analysis_queue = queue
    return queue
````

````python
"""Shared-queue adapter for autocompleter."""
from __future__ import annotations
from typing import Any
from PyQt5.QtCore import pyqtSignal
from code_inteligence.analysis_provider import AnalysisProvider


class AutoCompleter(AnalysisProvider):
    """Deliver plain completion names to the editor's existing QsciAPIs list."""
    completions_ready = pyqtSignal(int, list)
    error = pyqtSignal(str)

    def __init__(self, file_path: Any=None, api: Any=None, editor: Any=None) -> None:
        """Keep the legacy constructor arguments while accepting the owning tab."""
        super().__init__("completion", editor)
        self.file_path, self.api = file_path, api

    def get_completions(self, line: Any, index: Any, text: Any) -> Any:
        """Submit a captured buffer and return its UI generation."""
        return self.request(line, index, text, self.file_path)

    def deliver(self, generation: Any, value: Any) -> None:
        """Convert immutable worker results to the existing list signal."""
        if isinstance(value, Exception):
            self.error.emit(str(value))
        else:
            self.completions_ready.emit(generation, list(value))
````

````python
"""Shared-queue adapter for definition finder."""
from __future__ import annotations
from typing import Any
from PyQt5.QtCore import pyqtSignal
from code_inteligence.analysis_provider import AnalysisProvider


class DefinitionFinder(AnalysisProvider):
    """Resolve definitions without a separate QThread or concurrent Jedi call."""
    definition_found = pyqtSignal(int, str, int, int)
    definition_not_found = pyqtSignal(int)
    error = pyqtSignal(int, str)

    def __init__(self, editor: Any=None) -> None:
        """Use the same queue and environment as completion and documentation."""
        super().__init__("definition", editor)

    def find(self, line: Any, column: Any, code: Any, file_path: Any=None) -> Any:
        """Submit a definition request for an immutable source snapshot."""
        return self.request(line, column, code, file_path)

    def deliver(self, generation: Any, value: Any) -> None:
        """Preserve one-based result lines expected by PythonEditor."""
        if isinstance(value, Exception):
            self.error.emit(generation, str(value))
        elif value is None:
            self.definition_not_found.emit(generation)
        else:
            self.definition_found.emit(generation, *value)
````

````python
"""References adapter over the shared analysis queue."""
from __future__ import annotations
from typing import Any
from PyQt5.QtCore import pyqtSignal
from code_inteligence.analysis_provider import AnalysisProvider

class ReferencesFinder(AnalysisProvider):
    """Return plain references using the current editor's workspace and interpreter."""
    references_found = pyqtSignal(int, list)
    references_empty = pyqtSignal(int)
    error = pyqtSignal(int, str)

    def __init__(self, editor: Any=None) -> None:
        """Join the application queue instead of starting an independent Jedi thread."""
        super().__init__("references", editor)

    def find_references(self, line: int, column: int, code: str, file_path: str | None = None, workspace: str | None = None, interpreter: str | None = None) -> int | None:
        """Retain the public call signature while reading live context from the editor."""
        return self.request(line, column, code, file_path)

    def deliver(self, generation: int, value: Any) -> None:
        """Map immutable queue results to the existing references panel signals."""
        if isinstance(value, Exception):
            self.error.emit(generation, str(value))
        elif value:
            self.references_found.emit(generation, list(value))
        else:
            self.references_empty.emit(generation)
````

````python
"""Shared-queue adapter for signature helper."""
from __future__ import annotations
from typing import Any
from PyQt5.QtCore import pyqtSignal
from code_inteligence.analysis_provider import AnalysisProvider


class SignatureHelper(AnalysisProvider):
    """Publish signature text from the shared queue."""
    signature_ready = pyqtSignal(int, str)
    signature_empty = pyqtSignal(int)

    def __init__(self, editor: Any=None) -> None:
        """Bind the provider to the tab supplying environment and size policy."""
        super().__init__("signature", editor)

    def get_signatures(self, line: Any, column: Any, code: Any, file_path: Any=None) -> Any:
        """Submit a call-site snapshot using Jedi's one-based line numbers."""
        return self.request(line, column, code, file_path)

    def deliver(self, generation: Any, value: Any) -> None:
        """Publish a signature or request dismissal of an obsolete tooltip."""
        if isinstance(value, Exception) or not value:
            self.signature_empty.emit(generation)
        else:
            self.signature_ready.emit(generation, value)
````

**`MainWindow._restart_ruff`**

````python
    def _restart_ruff(
            self,
            python_executable: str | None = None,
            workspace_root: Path | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Replace the shared Ruff server after interpreter/workspace changes.

        Every open Python controller is reconnected to the new shared client.
        The old client then performs its asynchronous LSP shutdown. No editor
        owns a separate Ruff process.
        """
        executable = python_executable or self.python_runner.interpreter
        root = Path(workspace_root or self._workspace_root).resolve()
        self._workspace_root = root

        self.diagnostics_manager.clear_provider("ruff")
        self.references_panel.set_locations([])
        for view in self.tab_view.all_editors():
            if isinstance(view, PythonEditor):
                view.references_finder.invalidate()
        if getattr(self, "test_session", None) is not None:
            self.test_session.invalidate()
            self._test_context = None
        shared_analysis().invalidate_all()
        old_client = self.ruff_lsp_client
        client = RuffLspClient(
            python_executable=executable,
            workspace_root=root,
            parent=self,
        )
        client.server_error.connect(self._on_ruff_lsp_error)
        self.ruff_lsp_client = client

        for editor in self.tab_view.all_editors():
            if isinstance(editor, PythonEditor) and editor.ruff_lsp is not None:
                editor.ruff_lsp.set_client(client)

        old_client.shutdown()
        client.start()
````

**`MainWindow._background_work_running`**

````python
    def _background_work_running(self) -> bool:
        """Return whether an asynchronous component is still shutting down.

        Returns:
            True while an editor retirement, Git scan, project search, Python
            run, Ruff process, or terminal PTY worker remains active.

        The method is polled by `_finish_pending_close()` through QTimer. It
        must only inspect state and must never block the GUI thread.
        """
        if getattr(self, 'analysis_queue', None) is not None and self.analysis_queue.is_running():
            return True
        if getattr(self, "_hash_job", None) is not None and self._hash_job.isRunning():
            return True
        if getattr(self, 'profile_runner', None) is not None and self.profile_runner.process.state() != QProcess.NotRunning:
            return True
        if getattr(self, 'test_session', None) is not None and self.test_session.is_running():
            return True
        if getattr(self, "_symbol_job", None) is not None and self._symbol_job.isRunning():
            return True
        process = getattr(self, '_rename_process', None)
        if process is not None and process.state() != QProcess.NotRunning:
            return True
        process = getattr(self, '_comparison_process', None)
        if process is not None and process.state() != QProcess.NotRunning:
            return True
        """Return whether an asynchronous component is still shutting down.

        Returns:
            True while an editor retirement, Git scan, project search, Python
            run, Ruff process, or terminal PTY worker remains active.

        The method is polled by `_finish_pending_close()` through QTimer. It
        must only inspect state and must never block the GUI thread.
        """
        if self.file_watcher.is_running():
            return True
        git_worker = getattr(
            getattr(self, "file_manager", None),
            "git_checker",
            None,
        )
        search_worker = getattr(self, "search_worker", None)
        runner = getattr(self, "python_runner", None)
        ruff = getattr(self, "ruff_lsp_client", None)
        terminal = getattr(self, "terminal", None)
        git_service = getattr(self, "git_service", None)
        

        return bool(
            # Retired editors remain here until their workers are disposed.
            self._retired_editors

            # QThread-based background services use isRunning().
            or (git_worker is not None and git_worker.isRunning())
            or (search_worker is not None and search_worker.isRunning())
            or (git_service is not None and git_service.is_running())

            # PythonRunner exposes its own public running-state method.
            or (runner is not None and runner.is_running())

            # Ruff still uses QProcess, so its existing state check remains.
            or (
                ruff is not None
                and ruff.process.state() != QProcess.NotRunning
            )

            # The PTY terminal no longer owns a QProcess. Ask its public API
            # whether the _PtySession worker is still running.
            or (terminal is not None and terminal.is_running())
        )
````

**`MainWindow.closeEvent`**

````python
    def closeEvent(self, event: Any) -> Any:
        """Closeevent."""
        if getattr(self, "_close_ready", False):
            event.accept()
            return super().closeEvent(event)

        if not getattr(self, "_close_prompts_complete", False):
            # DirtyViews yields one representative per dirty document.
            for editor in list(self._dirty_editors):
                self.tab_view.focus_editor(editor)
                path = getattr(editor, "path", None)
                name = Path(path).name if path is not None else "Untitled"
                reply = QMessageBox.question(
                    self,
                    "Unsaved Changes",
                    f"Save changes to '{name}'?",
                    QMessageBox.Save | QMessageBox.Discard | QMessageBox.Cancel,
                    QMessageBox.Save,
                )
                if reply == QMessageBox.Cancel:
                    event.ignore()
                    return
                if reply == QMessageBox.Save and not self.save_file():
                    event.ignore()
                    return
            if self.recovery is not None:
                self.recovery.finish()
            self._close_prompts_complete = True
            self.save_session()

        for editor in list(self.tab_view.all_editors()):
            self.tab_view.remove_editor(editor)
            self._dispose_editor(editor)

        self.file_watcher.shutdown()
        process = getattr(self, '_comparison_process', None)
        if process is not None:
            process.kill()
        process = getattr(self, '_rename_process', None)
        if process is not None:
            process.kill()
        if getattr(self, "_symbol_job", None) is not None:
            self._symbol_job.requestInterruption()
        self.test_session.invalidate()
        self.profile_runner.stop()
        if getattr(self, "_hash_job", None) is not None:
            self._hash_job.requestInterruption()
        self.analysis_queue.shutdown()
        if self.terminal is not None:
            self.terminal.stop()
        if hasattr(self.python_runner, "shutdown"):
            self.python_runner.shutdown()
        else:
            # Compatibility until Fix 5 replaces PythonRunner.
            self.python_runner.stop()
        self.ruff_lsp_client.shutdown()
        if hasattr(self.search_worker, "shutdown"):
            self.search_worker.shutdown()
        self.settings.setValue("recent_files", self.recent_files)
        
        self.file_manager.git_checker.shutdown()
        self.git_service.shutdown()

        if self._background_work_running():
            event.ignore()
            QTimer.singleShot(100, self._finish_pending_close)
            return

        self._close_ready = True
        event.accept()
        super().closeEvent(event)
````

````python
    def __init__(self, parent: Any=None, path: Path = None, is_python_file: bool = True, ruff_lsp_client: Any = None) -> None:
        """Initialize this pythoneditor component."""
        super().__init__(parent)
        
        # Store the absolute logical file path. Ruff LSP uses it to form the stable
        # document UEI sent in didOpen/didChanged notifications.
        
        self.path = path
        self.full_path = self.path.absolute() if self.path else None
        self.is_python_file = is_python_file
        self.ruff_lsp = None
        self._manual_completion_generation = None

        self._ruff_hover_active = False
        self._loading_text = False
        self._shutting_down = False
        self._autocomplete_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._autocomplete_timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self._autocomplete_timer.setInterval(300)
        self._autocomplete_timer.timeout.connect(self._trigger_autocomplete)

        self._pending_line = 0
        self._pending_index = 0
        self.cursorPositionChanged.connect(self._cursorPositionChanged)

        self.setUtf8(True)

        # NOTE: no editor-level font anymore. The theme (via the lexer)
        # owns family, size, colors and paper — one source of truth.
        # The lexer is created below; helpers on it (editor_font(),
        # editor_color()) supply the margins/popup/caret values.

        self.setBraceMatching(QsciScintilla.SloppyBraceMatch)
        self.setIndentationGuides(True)
        self.setTabWidth(4)
        self.setIndentationsUseTabs(False)
        self.setAutoIndent(True)
        self.setEolMode(
            QsciScintilla.EolUnix if sys.platform != "win32" else QsciScintilla.EolWindows
        )
        self.setEolVisibility(False)

        self.setAutoCompletionSource(QsciScintilla.AcsAll)
        self.setAutoCompletionThreshold(2)
        self.setAutoCompletionCaseSensitivity(False)
        self.setAutoCompletionUseSingle(QsciScintilla.AcusNever)

        # Caret styling defaults; replaced by theme values once the lexer
        # exists (see _apply_theme_editor_style below + _apply_editor_settings
        # in main.py after a lexer swap). Kept as safe fallbacks so the
        # widget is never unstyled before a theme loads.
        self.setCaretForegroundColor(QColor("#f31122"))
        self.setCaretLineVisible(True)
        self.setCaretLineBackgroundColor(QColor("#3d424d"))
        self.setCaretWidth(2)

        if self.is_python_file:
            if ruff_lsp_client is not None:
                self.ruff_lsp = RuffLspController(editor=self, client=ruff_lsp_client, parent=self)


            self._ruff_hover_timer = QTimer(self)
            self._ruff_hover_timer.setSingleShot(True)
            self._ruff_hover_timer.setInterval(150)
            self._ruff_hover_timer.timeout.connect(self._trigger_ruff_hover)
            
            # An owned timer can be stopped when Space/Enter dismisses help.
            self._signature_timer = QTimer(self)
            self._signature_timer.setSingleShot(True)
            self._signature_timer.setInterval(50)
            self._signature_timer.timeout.connect(self._trigger_signature_help)
            self.signature_helper = SignatureHelper(self)
            self.signature_helper.signature_ready.connect(self._on_signature_ready)
            self.signature_helper.signature_empty.connect(self._on_signature_empty)

            self.hover_helper = HoverHelper(self)
            self.hover_helper.hover_info_ready.connect(self._on_hover_ready)
            self.hover_helper.hover_info_empty.connect(self._on_hover_empty)

            # DocumentationPopup ows only the UI. HoverHelper still performs
            # Jedi analysis is its worker thread and emits plain text results.
            # Create one popup for this editor tab. Passing self as parent means
            # Qt cleans it up automatically when this PythonEditor is destroyed.
            # The lexer loads the theme itself — font, colors and paper all
            # come from themes/theme.json (or the theme chosen in Settings).
            # Created FIRST so everything below can read its theme helpers.
            self.py_lexer = PyCustomLexer(self)

            self.documentation_popup = DocumentationPopup(self)
            self.documentation_popup.dismissed.connect(self._cancel_documentation)
            self._documentation_global_pos = None
            # Popup font follows the theme's global editor font (the old
            # self.window_font is gone — the lexer owns fonts now).
            self.documentation_popup.set_documentation_font(
                self.py_lexer.editor_font())

            self.setMouseTracking(True)

            self._apply_theme_editor_style()

            self._api = QsciAPIs(self.py_lexer)
            self.auto_completer = AutoCompleter(
                str(self.full_path) if self.full_path else None, self._api, self
            )
            self.auto_completer.completions_ready.connect(self._apply_completions)
            self.auto_completer.error.connect(self._handle_completion_error)

            self.setLexer(self.py_lexer)
        else:
            # No lexer in this mode yet (tab not converted): neutral defaults.
            # Once a lexer attaches, _apply_theme_editor_style takes over.
            self.setPaper(QColor("#1e1f22"))
            self.setColor(QColor("#abb2bf"))

        self.definition_finder = DefinitionFinder(self)
        self.definition_finder.definition_found.connect(self._on_definition_found)
        self.definition_finder.definition_not_found.connect(self._on_definition_not_found)
        self.definition_finder.error.connect(self._on_definition_error)

        # Margin 0: source-code line numbers.
        self.setMarginType(0, QsciScintilla.NumberMargin)
        self.setMarginWidth(0, "0000")

        # Margin 1: Ruff error, warning, information and quick-fix symbols.
        self.setMarginType(1, QsciScintilla.SymbolMargin)
        self.setMarginWidth(1, "000")

        ruff_marker_mask = (
            (1 << RuffDiagnosticView.ERROR_MARKER)
            | (1 << RuffDiagnosticView.WARNING_MARKER)
            | (1 << RuffDiagnosticView.INFO_MARKER)
            | (1 << RuffDiagnosticView.FIX_MARKER)
        )
        self.setMarginMarkerMask(1, ruff_marker_mask)

        self.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarAsNeeded)
        self.setWrapMode(QsciScintilla.WrapNone)

        # Final theme application (font, margins, caret, paper) — AFTER all
        # margin setup so nothing overrides it. The old hardcoded
        # setMarginsForegroundColor/BackgroundColor/setMarginsFont lines
        # that used to live here are replaced by this one theme-driven call.
        if getattr(self, "py_lexer", None) is not None:
            self._apply_theme_editor_style()

        self.minimap = EditorMinimap(self)
        self.minimap.set_map_visible(False)

        self.folding_controller = FoldingController(self, "python")

        self.snippets = SnippetController(self)

        self.references_finder = ReferencesFinder(self)
        self.references_finder.references_found.connect(self._references_found)
        self.references_finder.references_empty.connect(lambda generation: self._references_found(generation, []))
        self.references_finder.error.connect(self._references_error)
        # A result computed from older buffer contents must never be displayed.
        self.textChanged.connect(self.references_finder.invalidate)
````

````python
from __future__ import annotations
from code_inteligence.jedi_guard import serialized_jedi
from PyQt5.QtCore import QThread, pyqtSignal
from jedi import Script


class AutoCompleter(QThread):
    """Request semantic completions and show suggestions for the current buffer."""
    completions_ready = pyqtSignal(int, list)
    error = pyqtSignal(str)

    def __init__(self, file_path, api=None):
        super().__init__(None)
        self.file_path = file_path
        self.api = api
        self._generation = 0
        self._running_generation = 0
        self._request = (1, 0, "")
        self._pending = None
        self._shutting_down = False
        self.finished.connect(self._start_pending)

    def get_completions(self, line, index, text):
        if self._shutting_down:
            return None
        self._generation += 1
        request = (self._generation, line, index, text)
        if self.isRunning():
            self._pending = request
        else:
            self._start_request(request)
        return self._generation

    def invalidate(self):
        """Invalidate a running result when the editor revision/position changes."""
        self._generation += 1
        self._pending = None

    def _start_request(self, request):
        generation, line, index, text = request
        lines = text.splitlines() or [""]
        line = max(1, min(line, len(lines)))
        index = max(0, min(index, len(lines[line - 1])))
        self._running_generation = generation
        self._request = (line, index, text)
        self.start()

    def _start_pending(self):
        if not self._shutting_down and self._pending is not None:
            request, self._pending = self._pending, None
            self._start_request(request)

    @serialized_jedi
    def run(self) -> None:
        """Run."""
        try:
            line, index, text = self._request
            names = [item.name for item in Script(
                code=text, path=self.file_path
            ).complete(line, index)]
            if not self._shutting_down:
                self.completions_ready.emit(self._running_generation, names)
        except Exception as error:
            if not self._shutting_down:
                self.error.emit(str(error))

    def shutdown(self):
        self._shutting_down = True
        self._pending = None
        self.requestInterruption()

    @property
    def generation(self):
        return self._generation
````

````python
from jedi import Script


class DefinitionFinder(QThread):
    """Find definitions asynchronously and replay the most recent request."""

    definition_found = pyqtSignal(int, str, int, int)
    definition_not_found = pyqtSignal(int)
    error = pyqtSignal(int, str)

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(None)
        self._generation = 0
        self._request = None
        self._pending = None
        self._shutting_down = False
        self.finished.connect(self._start_pending)

    def find(self, line: int, column: int, code: str, file_path: str = None):
        if self._shutting_down:
            return
        self._generation += 1
        request = (self._generation, line, column, code, file_path)
        if self.isRunning():
            self._pending = request
            return
        self._request = request
        self.start()

    def invalidate(self):
        self._generation += 1
        self._pending = None

    def _start_pending(self):
        if self._shutting_down or self._pending is None:
            return
        self._request, self._pending = self._pending, None
        self.start()

    def run(self) -> None:
        """Run."""
        generation, line, column, code, file_path = self._request
        try:
            definitions = Script(code=code, path=file_path).goto(
                line=line, column=column, follow_imports=True
            )
            if self._shutting_down:
                return
            if not definitions or definitions[0].module_path is None:
                self.definition_not_found.emit(generation)
                return
            definition = definitions[0]
            self.definition_found.emit(
                generation, str(definition.module_path), definition.line, definition.column
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            if not self._shutting_down:
                self.error.emit(generation, str(exc))

    @property
    def generation(self):
        return self._generation

    def shutdown(self):
        self._shutting_down = True
        self._pending = None
        self.requestInterruption()
````

````python
from __future__ import annotations
from typing import Any
from PyQt5.QtCore import pyqtSignal
from code_inteligence.analysis_provider import AnalysisProvider


class DefinitionFinder(AnalysisProvider):
    """Resolve definitions without a separate QThread or concurrent Jedi call."""
    definition_found = pyqtSignal(int, str, int, int)
    definition_not_found = pyqtSignal(int)
    error = pyqtSignal(int, str)

    def __init__(self, editor: Any=None) -> None:
        """Use the same queue and environment as completion and documentation."""
        super().__init__("definition", editor)

    def find(self, line: Any, column: Any, code: Any, file_path: Any=None) -> Any:
        """Submit a definition request for an immutable source snapshot."""
        return self.request(line, column, code, file_path)

    def deliver(self, generation: Any, value: Any) -> None:
        """Preserve one-based result lines expected by PythonEditor."""
        if isinstance(value, Exception):
            self.error.emit(generation, str(value))
        elif value is None:
            self.definition_not_found.emit(generation)
        else:
            self.definition_found.emit(generation, *value)
````

````python
    hover_info_empty = pyqtSignal(int)

        super().__init__(None)
        self._generation = 0
        self._request = None
        self._pending = None
        self._shutting_down = False

            return

        self.start()

        self._pending = None

            name = results[0]

            if name.type:

            else:
                self.hover_info_empty.emit(generation)
        except Exception:
            if not self._shutting_down:
                self.hover_info_empty.emit(generation)

    @property
    def generation(self):
        return self._generation

    def shutdown(self):
        self._shutting_down = True
        self._pending = None
        self.requestInterruption()
````

````python
from __future__ import annotations
from typing import Any
from code_inteligence.jedi_guard import serialized_jedi
from PyQt5.QtCore import QThread, pyqtSignal
from jedi import Script, Project, create_environment
import jedi
# The existing helpers run concurrently; disable Jedi's shared mutable fast parser.
jedi.settings.fast_parser = True


class ReferencesFinder(QThread):
    """Find references without blocking, replaying only the newest request."""

    references_found = pyqtSignal(int, list)
    references_empty = pyqtSignal(int)
    error = pyqtSignal(int, str)

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        """Initialize latest-request generations and replay pending work after the active thread finishes."""
        super().__init__(None)
        self._generation = 0
        self._request = None
        self._pending = None
        self._shutting_down = False
        self.finished.connect(self._start_pending)

    def find_references(self, line: Any, column: Any, code: Any, file_path: Any=None, workspace: Any=None, interpreter: Any=None) -> Any:
        """Capture plain source, caret, project and interpreter values for the newest request."""
        if self._shutting_down:
            return None
        self._generation += 1
        request = (self._generation, line, column, code, file_path, workspace, interpreter)
        if self.isRunning():
            self._pending = request
        else:
            self._request = request
            self.start()
        return self._generation

    def _start_pending(self) -> None:
        """Start only the most recent queued request when the previous worker finishes."""
        if self._shutting_down or self._pending is None:
            return
        self._request, self._pending = self._pending, None
        self.start()

    @serialized_jedi
    def run(self) -> None:
        """Run semantic Jedi reference lookup off the GUI thread and emit plain locations or an error."""
        generation, line, column, code, file_path, workspace, interpreter = self._request
        try:
            names = Script(code=code, path=file_path, project=Project(workspace) if workspace else None,
                           environment=create_environment(interpreter, safe=False) if interpreter else None).get_references(
                line=line, column=column, include_builtins=False
            )
            if self._shutting_down:
                return
            references = [
                (str(name.module_path), name.line - 1, name.column, name.name)
                for name in names
                if name.module_path is not None
            ]
            if references:
                self.references_found.emit(generation, references)
            else:
                self.references_empty.emit(generation)
        except Exception as exc:
            if not self._shutting_down:
                self.error.emit(generation, str(exc))

    def shutdown(self):
        """Reject future/results requests; completion remains asynchronous."""
        self._shutting_down = True
        self._pending = None
        self.requestInterruption()

    def invalidate(self) -> None:
        """Reject in-flight results without forcibly terminating a running thread."""
        self._generation += 1
        self._pending = None

    @property
    def generation(self) -> Any:
        """Expose the current GUI-side request generation for delivery checks."""
        return self._generation
````

````python
    signature_empty = pyqtSignal(int)
````
