````python
"""Connect type and spelling providers to shared documents and the Problems panel."""
from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any
from PyQt5 import sip
from PyQt5.QtCore import QObject, QTimer, QProcess
from ruff_implementation.diagnostics_model import Diagnostic, DiagnosticSeverity, Position, SourceRange
from ruff_implementation.ruff_diagnostics_model import RuffDiagnostic, RuffPosition, RuffSeverity
from ruff_implementation.ruff_diagnostics_view import RuffDiagnosticView
from ruff_implementation.type_client import TypeClient

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from main import MainWindow


class ProviderBridge(QObject):
    """Synchronize each shared Python document once and reject outdated results."""

    def __init__(self, window: MainWindow) -> None:
        """Keep one type server and one small change-detection timer per window."""
        super().__init__(window)
        self.window = window
        self.client = TypeClient(window.python_runner.interpreter, window._workspace_root, self)
        self.sent: dict[str, int] = {}
        self.current: dict[str, Any] = {}
        self.closed: bool = False
        self.client.diagnostics_published.connect(self.receive_types)
        self.client.server_ready.connect(self.resync)
        self.client.server_error.connect(lambda message: window.statusBar().showMessage(message, 8000))
        self.timer = QTimer(self)
        self.timer.setInterval(250)
        self.timer.timeout.connect(self.sync)
        self.timer.start()
        window.diagnostics_manager.collectionChanged.connect(self.paint)
        self.client.start()

    def resync(self) -> None:
        """Reopen current buffers after a server restart."""
        self.sent.clear()
        self.sync()

    def sync(self) -> None:
        """Read text only when its version changes; never read widgets in worker threads."""
        if self.closed:
            return
        for retired in list(self.window._retired_type_clients):
            if retired.process.state() == QProcess.NotRunning:
                self.window._retired_type_clients.remove(retired)
                retired.deleteLater()
        live: dict[str, Any] = {}
        for document in self.window.documents.all():
            editor = document.analysis_owner
            controller = getattr(editor, "ruff_lsp", None)
            if controller is None or getattr(editor, "large_file_mode", False):
                continue
            uri: str = controller.uri
            live[uri] = controller
            revision: int = controller.document_version
            if self.client.is_ready and self.sent.get(uri) != revision:
                source: str = editor.text()
                if uri not in self.sent:
                    self.client.open_document(uri, source, revision)
                else:
                    self.client.change_document(uri, source, revision)
                self.sent[uri] = revision
        for uri in self.current.keys() - live.keys():
            self.client.close_document(uri)
            self.sent.pop(uri, None)
            self.window.diagnostics_manager.clear_document(uri)
        self.current = live

    def receive_types(self, uri: str, rows: list[dict[str, Any]], revision: int | None) -> None:
        """Convert UTF-16 columns only for an exact, current buffer version."""
        controller = self.current.get(uri)
        if self.closed or controller is None or controller._closed or sip.isdeleted(controller.editor) or revision is None or revision != controller.document_version:
            return
        source: str = controller.editor.text()
        lines: list[str] = source.split("\n")
        def position(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> Position:
            """Convert one LSP code-unit offset into a Python-character offset."""
            line: int = min(max(int(raw.get("line", 0)), 0), len(lines) - 1)
            units: int = max(int(raw.get("character", 0)), 0)
            column: int = len(lines[line].encode("utf-16-le")[:units * 2].decode("utf-16-le", "ignore"))
            return Position(line, column)
        result: list[Diagnostic] = []
        for row in rows:
            span = row.get("range", {})
            result.append(Diagnostic("basedpyright", uri, controller.editor.path,
                SourceRange(position(span.get("start", {})), position(span.get("end", {}))),
                {1: DiagnosticSeverity.ERROR, 2: DiagnosticSeverity.WARNING}.get(row.get("severity"), DiagnosticSeverity.INFORMATION),
                str(row.get("code", "type")), str(row.get("message", "")), revision))
        self.window.diagnostics_manager.replace("basedpyright", uri, result)

    def paint(self, provider: str, uri: str, rows: list[Diagnostic]) -> None:
        """Update only the changed provider's indicators, preserving pending providers."""
        if provider == "ruff":
            return  # Ruff's existing controller owns indicators 20–23.
        for document in self.window.documents.all():
            controller = getattr(document.analysis_owner, "ruff_lsp", None)
            if controller is None or controller.uri != uri:
                continue
            for editor in document.views:
                views: dict[str, RuffDiagnosticView] = getattr(editor, "_provider_views", {})
                editor._provider_views = views
                if provider not in views:
                    view = RuffDiagnosticView.__new__(RuffDiagnosticView)
                    view.editor, view.by_line = editor, {}
                    base: int = 24 if provider == "basedpyright" else 28
                    marker_base: int = 8 if provider == "basedpyright" else 12
                    view.ERROR_INDICATOR = base
                    view.ERROR_MARKER = marker_base
                    view.WARNING_INDICATOR = base + 1
                    view.WARNING_MARKER = marker_base + 1
                    view.INFO_INDICATOR = base + 2
                    view.INFO_MARKER = marker_base + 2
                    # Indicators and markers use separate ID spaces.
                    # Marker IDs 25–31 are reserved for Scintilla folding.
                    view.FIX_INDICATOR = base + 3
                    view.FIX_MARKER = marker_base + 3
                    view._define_visuals()
                    views[provider] = view
                views[provider].render([RuffDiagnostic(
                    code=f"{provider}: {row.code}", message=row.message,
                    severity=RuffSeverity(int(row.severity)),
                    start=RuffPosition(row.source_range.start.line, row.source_range.start.column),
                    end=RuffPosition(row.source_range.end.line, row.source_range.end.column),
                    revision=row.revision or 0) for row in rows])

    def restart(self) -> None:
        """Replace the server after the selected interpreter or workspace changes."""
        old = self.client
        old.diagnostics_published.disconnect(self.receive_types)
        old.server_ready.disconnect(self.resync)
        old.shutdown()
        # Keep the retired QProcess parented until it has actually stopped.
        self.window._retired_type_clients.append(old)
        self.client = TypeClient(self.window.python_runner.interpreter, self.window._workspace_root, self)
        self.client.diagnostics_published.connect(self.receive_types)
        self.client.server_ready.connect(self.resync)
        self.client.server_error.connect(lambda message: self.window.statusBar().showMessage(message, 8000))
        self.sent.clear()
        self.window.diagnostics_manager.clear_provider("basedpyright")
        self.client.start()

    def shutdown(self) -> None:
        """Stop submissions while the window retains live child-process ownership."""
        self.closed = True
        self.timer.stop()
        self.client.shutdown()
````

````python
"""Bridge one PythonEditor document to the shared Ruff languafe server."""

from __future__ import annotations
from typing import Any
from PyQt5.QtCore import QPoint
from PyQt5.QtWidgets import QMenu, QMessageBox
from ruff_implementation.workspace_edit import WorkspaceEditApplier, WorkspaceEditError


from pathlib import Path
from uuid import uuid4

from PyQt5.QtCore import QObject, QTimer, pyqtSignal
from PyQt5.QtWidgets import QToolTip

from ruff_implementation.ruff_diagnostics_model import RuffDiagnostic, RuffPosition, RuffSeverity
from ruff_implementation.ruff_diagnostics_view import RuffDiagnosticView

class RuffLspController(QObject):
    """Keep one QScintilla Python document synchronized with Ruff LSP."""
    diagnostics_changed = pyqtSignal(object, list)
    
    def __init__(self, editor, client, parent=None):
        # Parent this controller to the editor unless a different explicit parent was supplied.
        # Destroying the tab then also destroys its controller.
        super().__init__(parent or editor)

        self.editor = editor
        self.client = client
        self._uri = self._uri_for_path(editor.full_path)
        
        # Reuse the existing visual layer. It remains responsible only for QScintilla
        # indicators, marker circles, tooltips and range caching.
        self.view = RuffDiagnosticView(editor)
        
        # LSP versions begin at an integer and must increase for every didChange.
        self.document_version = 1
        
        # didOpen must be sent exactly once per URI/server lifecycle.
        self._opened = False
        self._closed = False
        
        # Full-buffer updates are delayed slightly while a user is typing.
        # This prevents sending one didChange messafe for every individual keypress.
        self.change_timer = QTimer(self)
        self.change_timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self.change_timer.setInterval(180)
        self.change_timer.timeout.connect(self._send_change)
        
        # QScintilla emits textChanged for user input, pasted text, fixes, etc.
        editor.textChanged.connect(self._on_text_changed)
        
        # If Ruff is still starting when this tab is constructed, open_document
        # wil run as soon as initialize/initialized completes.
        client.server_ready.connect(self.open_document)
        client.server_stopped.connect(self._on_server_stopped)

        client.diagnostics_published.connect(self._on_diagnostics_published)
        if client.is_ready:
            self.open_document()
    
    @property
    def uri(self) -> str:
        """Return the stable LSP URI identifying this document to Ruff."""
        return self._uri

    @staticmethod
    def _uri_for_path(path) -> str:
        if path is None:
            path = Path.cwd() / f"untitled-{uuid4().hex}.py"
        return Path(path).resolve().as_uri()

    def _on_server_stopped(self):
        self._opened = False

    def relocate(self, path: Any) -> None:
        """Migrate this open buffer to a new URI after Save As or rename."""
        self._clear_problem_rows()
        old_uri = self._uri
        if self._opened and self.client.is_ready:
            self.client.close_document(old_uri)
        self._uri = self._uri_for_path(path)
        self._opened = False
        self.document_version += 1
        self.open_document()

    def set_client(self, client):
        """Reconnect this document when the selected Ruff interpreter changes."""
        try:
            self.client.server_ready.disconnect(self.open_document)
            self.client.server_stopped.disconnect(self._on_server_stopped)
            self.client.diagnostics_published.disconnect(self._on_diagnostics_published)
        except TypeError:
            pass
        self.client = client
        self._opened = False
        client.server_ready.connect(self.open_document)
        client.server_stopped.connect(self._on_server_stopped)
        client.diagnostics_published.connect(self._on_diagnostics_published)
        if client.is_ready:
            self.open_document()
        
    def open_document(self) -> None:
        """Send didOpen once after the shared server is ready."""
        if getattr(self.editor, "large_file_mode", False):
            return
        """Send didOpen once after the shared server is ready."""
        if self._closed or self._opened or not self.client.is_ready:
            return
        
        self.client.open_document(
            self.uri,
            self.editor.text(),
            self.document_version,
        )
        self._opened = True
        
    def sync_from_editor(self) -> None:
        """Syncronize editor text after programmatic loading with blocked signals."""
        if getattr(self.editor, "large_file_mode", False):
            return
        """Syncronize editor text after programmatic loading with blocked signals."""
        if self._closed:
            return
            
        # setTextSafely() blocks editor.textChanged while loading a disk file.
        # Therefore this method manually creates a new LSP document version for the newly loaded source text.
        self.document_version += 1
        
        if not self._opened:
            # Ruff may still be starting. If it is ready, this sends didOpen with the current loaded text.
            # If it is not ready yet, the existing server_ready -> open_document signal connection will do so later.
            self.open_document()
            return
        
        if not self.client.is_ready:
            return
            
        # The Ruff server already knows this document, but perbiously recieved the empty editor text during 
        # PythonEditor construction. Replace it immediately with the actual source read from disk.
        self.client.change_document(self.uri, self.editor.text(), self.document_version)
    
    def _on_text_changed(self) -> None:
        """Advance document version and schedule one debounced didChange."""
        if getattr(self.editor, "large_file_mode", False):
            return
        """Advance document version and schedule one debounced didChange."""
        self._clear_problem_rows()
        if self._closed:
            return
        
        # Each text state must have a stricly newer version that the last.
        self.document_version += 1
        
        # Normally MainWindow starts Ruff before editors are made. This fallback
        # makes the controller safe if a tab is created during server startup.
        if not self._opened:
            self.open_document()
        
        if self._opened:
            # Calling start() again on s single-shot timer resets its countdown.
            # One change is sent only after typing has been idle for 180 ms.
            self.change_timer.start()

    def _send_change(self) -> None:
        """Transmit the current complete QScintilla text buffer to Ruff."""
        if getattr(self.editor, "large_file_mode", False):
            return
        """Transmit the current complete QScintilla text buffer to Ruff."""
        if self._closed or not self._opened or not self.client.is_ready:
            return

        self.client.change_document(
            self.uri,
            self.editor.text(),
            self.document_version,
        )

    def _lsp_column_to_character(self, line: int, column: int) -> int:
        """Translate negotiated LSP units into QScintilla character columns."""
        if line < 0 or line >= self.editor.lines():
            return 0
        value = self.editor.text(line).rstrip("\r\n")
        column = max(0, int(column))
        encoding = getattr(self.client, "position_encoding", "utf-16")
        if encoding == "utf-8":
            raw = value.encode("utf-8")[:column]
            return len(raw.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore"))
        if encoding == "utf-16":
            raw = value.encode("utf-16-le")[: column * 2]
            return len(raw.decode("utf-16-le", errors="ignore"))
        return min(column, len(value))

    def _on_diagnostics_published(self, uri: str, raw_diagnostics, version):
        """Render only current diagnostics belonging to this document."""
        if self._closed or uri != self.uri:
            return
        if version is not None and version != self.document_version:
            return

        diagnostics = [self._to_diagnostic(raw) for raw in raw_diagnostics]
        self.view.render(diagnostics)
        # MainWindow owns the cat/XP state; the controller only reports data.
        self.diagnostics_changed.emit(self.editor, diagnostics)

    def _to_diagnostic(self, raw: dict) -> RuffDiagnostic:
        """Convert one LSP diagnostic, including negotiated column units."""
        raw_range = raw.get("range") or {}
        start = raw_range.get("start") or {}
        end = raw_range.get("end") or start
        start_line = max(0, int(start.get("line", 0)))
        last_line = max(0, self.editor.lines() - 1)
        start_line = min(start_line, last_line)
        end_line = min(last_line, max(start_line, int(end.get("line", start_line))))

        severity_by_number = {
            1: RuffSeverity.ERROR,
            2: RuffSeverity.WARNING,
            3: RuffSeverity.INFO,
            4: RuffSeverity.INFO,
        }
        code = raw.get("code", "Ruff")
        if not isinstance(code, str):
            code = str(code)

        return RuffDiagnostic(
            code=code,
            message=str(raw.get("message", "Ruff diagnostic")),
            severity=severity_by_number.get(raw.get("severity"), RuffSeverity.WARNING),
            start=RuffPosition(
                start_line,
                self._lsp_column_to_character(start_line, start.get("character", 0)),
            ),
            end=RuffPosition(
                end_line,
                self._lsp_column_to_character(end_line, end.get("character", 0)),
            ),
            revision=self.document_version,
            raw=raw,
        )

    def hover(self, position) -> bool:
        """Show a short diagnostic tooltip for the current line, if any."""
        # SCI_POSITIONFROMPOINT (2022) returns a Scintilla byte position at the
        # mouse coordinate. -1 means the pointer is outside text content.
        byte_position = self.editor.SendScintilla(
            2022,
            position.x(),
            position.y(),
        )
        if byte_position < 0:
            QToolTip.hideText()
            return False

        # Convert byte position to a zero-based line number. UTF-8 decode with
        # errors=ignore handles a pointer position inside a multi-byte character.
        prefix = self.editor.text().encode("utf-8")[:byte_position].decode(
            "utf-8",
            errors="ignore",
        )
        diagnostic = self.view.at_line(prefix.count("\n"))

        if diagnostic:
            QToolTip.showText(
                self.editor.mapToGlobal(position),
                self.view.tooltip(diagnostic),
                self.editor,
            )
            return True

        QToolTip.hideText()
        return False

    def context_menu(self, event: Any, view: Any=None) -> bool | None:
        """Display current Ruff quick fixes without retaining the temporary Qt event."""
        view = view or self.editor
        position = view.SendScintilla(view.SCI_POSITIONFROMPOINT, event.pos().x(), event.pos().y())
        if position < 0:
            return False
        line, _column = self.editor.lineIndexFromPosition(position)
        diagnostic = self.view.at_line(line)
        if diagnostic is None:
            return False
        point = QPoint(event.globalPos())
        def receive(actions: Any, error: Any, uri: Any, revision: Any) -> None:
            """Show returned action titles and apply only the explicitly selected item."""
            if error:
                QMessageBox.warning(self.editor, "Quick fixes", str(error))
                return
            menu = QMenu(self.editor)
            pairs = []
            for action in actions:
                if not isinstance(action, dict):
                    continue
                item = menu.addAction(str(action.get("title", "Quick fix")))
                item.setEnabled(not bool(action.get("disabled")))
                pairs.append((item, action))
            if not pairs:
                menu.addAction("No quick fix available").setEnabled(False)
            chosen = menu.exec_(point)
            for item, action in pairs:
                if chosen is item:
                    try:
                        self.apply_code_action(action, uri, revision)
                    except WorkspaceEditError as error:
                        QMessageBox.warning(self.editor, "Quick fixes", str(error))
                    break
        self.request_quick_fixes(diagnostic, receive)
        return True

    def shutdown(self) -> None:
        """Stop synchronization, tell Ruff the tab is closed, clear visuals."""
        self._clear_problem_rows()
        if self._closed:
            return
        self._closed = True
        self.change_timer.stop()
        # didClose is sent only after didOpen; otherwise the server has never
        # heard about this document and closing it would be meaningless.
        if self._opened:
            self.client.close_document(self.uri)
        try:
            self.client.server_ready.disconnect(self.open_document)
            self.client.server_stopped.disconnect(self._on_server_stopped)
            self.client.diagnostics_published.disconnect(self._on_diagnostics_published)
        except TypeError:
            pass
        self.view.clear()

    def _clear_problem_rows(self) -> None:
        """Remove this URI's Problems rows when its text or lifecycle changes."""
        manager = getattr(self.editor.window(), "diagnostics_manager", None)
        if manager is not None:
            manager.replace("ruff", self.uri, [])

    def request_quick_fixes(self, diagnostic: Any, callback: Any) -> None:
        """Request actions with raw provider data and capture the exact document identity."""
        uri, revision, client = self.uri, self.document_version, self.client
        if self._closed or diagnostic.revision != revision or not client.is_ready:
            callback([], {"message": "Diagnostic is stale"}, uri, revision)
            return
        self.change_timer.stop()
        self._send_change()
        def receive(result: Any, error: Any) -> None:
            """Discard replies after closure, relocation, editing or server replacement."""
            if self._closed or client is not self.client or self.uri != uri or self.document_version != revision:
                return
            callback(result if isinstance(result, list) else [], error, uri, revision)
        client.request("textDocument/codeAction", {
            "textDocument": {"uri": uri}, "range": diagnostic.raw["range"],
            "context": {"diagnostics": [diagnostic.raw], "only": ["quickfix"], "triggerKind": 1}}, receive)

    def apply_code_action(self, action: Any, uri: Any, revision: Any) -> None:
        """Apply a direct edit completely or report an unsupported action form."""
        if action.get("disabled") or action.get("command") or not isinstance(action.get("edit"), dict):
            raise WorkspaceEditError("This action needs an unsupported command or resolve step")
        WorkspaceEditApplier(self).apply(action["edit"], uri, revision)
````

````python
        """Return whether an asynchronous component is still shutting down.

        Returns:
            True while an editor retirement, Git scan, project search, Python
            run, Ruff process, or terminal PTY worker remains active.

        The method is polled by `_finish_pending_close()` through QTimer. It
        must only inspect state and must never block the GUI thread.
        """
        if hasattr(self, "providers"):
            clients = [self.providers.client, *self._retired_type_clients]
            if any(client.process.state() != QProcess.NotRunning for client in clients):
                return True
        if getattr(self, 'analysis_queue', None) is not None and self.analysis_queue.is_running():
            return True
        if getattr(self, "_hash_job", None) is not None and self._hash_job.isRunning():
            return True
        if getattr(self, 'profile_runner', None) is not None and self.profile_runner.process.state() != QProcess.NotRunning:
            return True
        if getattr(self, 'test_session', None) is not None and self.test_session.is_running():
            return True
        if getattr(self, "_symbol_job", None) is not None and self._symbol_job.isRunning():
            return True
        process = getattr(self, '_rename_process', None)
        if process is not None and process.state() != QProcess.NotRunning:
            return True
        process = getattr(self, '_comparison_process', None)
        if process is not None and process.state() != QProcess.NotRunning:
            return True
        """Return whether an asynchronous component is still shutting down.

        Returns:
            True while an editor retirement, Git scan, project search, Python
            run, Ruff process, or terminal PTY worker remains active.

        The method is polled by `_finish_pending_close()` through QTimer. It
        must only inspect state and must never block the GUI thread.
        """
        if self.file_watcher.is_running():
            return True
        git_worker = getattr(
            getattr(self, "file_manager", None),
            "git_checker",
            None,
        )
        search_worker = getattr(self, "search_worker", None)
        runner = getattr(self, "python_runner", None)
        ruff = getattr(self, "ruff_lsp_client", None)
        terminal = getattr(self, "terminal", None)
        git_service = getattr(self, "git_service", None)
        

        return bool(
            # Retired editors remain here until their workers are disposed.
            self._retired_editors

            # QThread-based background services use isRunning().
            or (git_worker is not None and git_worker.isRunning())
            or (search_worker is not None and search_worker.isRunning())
            or (git_service is not None and git_service.is_running())

            # PythonRunner exposes its own public running-state method.
            or (runner is not None and runner.is_running())

            # Ruff still uses QProcess, so its existing state check remains.
            or (
                ruff is not None
                and ruff.process.state() != QProcess.NotRunning
            )

            # The PTY terminal no longer owns a QProcess. Ask its public API
            # whether the _PtySession worker is still running.
            or (terminal is not None and terminal.is_running())
        )
````

````python
    def _restart_ruff(

        """Replace the shared Ruff server after interpreter/workspace changes.

        Every open Python controller is reconnected to the new shared client.
        The old client then performs its asynchronous LSP shutdown. No editor
````

````python
        if self._hacker:
````

````python
    """Store complete diagnostic snapshots by provider and document."""

    changed = pyqtSignal(list)

    def __init__(self, parent: Any=None) -> None:
        """Create an empty provider/document snapshot map owned by the GUI thread."""
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._collections: dict[tuple[str, str], tuple[Diagnostic, ...]] = {}

    def replace(self, provider: str, uri: str, diagnostics: list[Diagnostic]) -> None:
        """Validate snapshot identity and replace or remove exactly one provider/document collection."""
        if any(item.provider != provider or item.uri != uri for item in diagnostics):
            raise ValueError("Diagnostic collection identity does not match its contents")
        key = (provider, uri)
        if diagnostics:
            self._collections[key] = tuple(diagnostics)
        else:
            self._collections.pop(key, None)
        self.changed.emit(self.all())

    def clear_document(self, uri: str) -> None:
        """Remove every provider collection belonging to one document URI."""
        self._collections = {key: value for key, value in self._collections.items()
                             if key[1] != uri}
        self.changed.emit(self.all())

    def clear_provider(self, provider: str) -> None:
        """Remove a provider after its environment or server instance changes."""
        self._collections = {key: value for key, value in self._collections.items()
                             if key[0] != provider}
        self.changed.emit(self.all())

    def all(self) -> list[Diagnostic]:
        """Return a deterministic severity/path/position ordering of all retained diagnostics."""
````

````python
    """Store complete diagnostic snapshots by provider and document."""

    changed = pyqtSignal(list)
    collectionChanged = pyqtSignal(str, str, list)

    def __init__(self, parent: Any=None) -> None:
        """Create an empty provider/document snapshot map owned by the GUI thread."""
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._collections: dict[tuple[str, str], tuple[Diagnostic, ...]] = {}

    def replace(self, provider: str, uri: str, diagnostics: list[Diagnostic]) -> None:
        """Validate snapshot identity and replace or remove exactly one provider/document collection."""
        if any(item.provider != provider or item.uri != uri for item in diagnostics):
            raise ValueError("Diagnostic collection identity does not match its contents")
        key = (provider, uri)
        if diagnostics:
            self._collections[key] = tuple(diagnostics)
        else:
            self._collections.pop(key, None)
        self.collectionChanged.emit(provider, uri, diagnostics)
        self.changed.emit(self.all())

    def clear_document(self, uri: str) -> None:
        """Clear exactly this document in each provider and its visual layer."""
        for provider, document_uri in list(self._collections):
            if document_uri == uri:
                self.replace(provider, uri, [])

    def clear_provider(self, provider: str) -> None:
        """Clear a stopped provider without disturbing other providers."""
        for source, uri in list(self._collections):
            if source == provider:
                self.replace(provider, uri, [])

    def all(self) -> list[Diagnostic]:
        """Return a deterministic severity/path/position ordering of all retained diagnostics."""
````

<a id="topic-44"></a>

## Topic 44: English and German spelling checks

### 1. Topic explanation

Use pyspellchecker’s bundled English and German dictionaries; no separate system spell-checker executable is required. Tokenize Python names, comments, strings and docstrings, split snake/camel identifiers and preserve source positions. Run immutable snapshots through the shared queue, cap findings at 500 and allow project terms in .markdowneditor-spelling.txt. Spelling is advisory and never automatically changes identifiers.

**Current implementation:** Added by this chapter.

**Prerequisites:** Topic 40, Topic 43. Keep all preceding cumulative changes.

**Documentation used:**

- [pyspellchecker API](https://pyspellchecker.readthedocs.io/en/latest/code.html)
- [Python 3.11 abstract syntax trees](https://docs.python.org/3.11/library/ast.html)

### 2. Topic code

#### `.markdowneditor-spelling.txt` — new module

Read the complete target file below. Section 3 specifies its installation; do not install a second copy.

````text
# Accepted project terms, one entry per line.
QScintilla
PyQt
basedpyright
Ruff
Markdown
````

````python
    def __init__(self) -> None:

        self.recent_files = self.settings.value("recent_files", [], type=list)
        self.ruff_save_mode = self.settings.value("ruff_save_mode", "safe_format", type=str)
        self.update_available.connect(self._show_update_dialog)
        # retirement statement of all the Python workers
        self._retired_editors = set()
        self._retired_type_clients = []

        # Detect if running as a bundled exe
        if hasattr(sys, "_MEIPASS"):
            # Running as PyInstaller exe — sys.executable is the editor itself.
            # Try to find a real Python installation on the system.
            import shutil

            found_python = shutil.which("python") or shutil.which("python3")
            if found_python:
                self.python_runner.set_interpreter(found_python)
            else:
                # No Python found — load from settings or let user pick

        self.test_session.output.connect(self.tests_dock.append)

        self.local_history = None
        try:
            self.local_history = LocalHistory(Path(QStandardPaths.writableLocation(
                QStandardPaths.AppLocalDataLocation)) / 'history')
        except OSError as error:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, 'History unavailable', str(error))
        self.recovery = None
        try:
            self.recovery = RecoveryManager(self)
            QTimer.singleShot(0, self.recovery.offer)
        except OSError as error:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, 'Recovery unavailable', str(error))
        self.console_dock.setObjectName('ConsoleDock')
        self.terminal_dock.setObjectName('TerminalDock')
        self.focus_mode = FocusMode(self)
        self._welcome_visible = False
        self._welcome_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._welcome_timer.timeout.connect(self._refresh_welcome)
        self._welcome_timer.start(250)
        self._install_minimap()
        self._install_folding()
        self._install_snippets()
        self._install_file_watching()
        self._install_document_tabs()
        self._install_references()
        self._install_problems()
        self._install_command_palette()
        
        self.outline_empty = EmptyState(self.outline_tree, 'No outline entries.\nOpen a document with headings or declarations.')
        self.search_empty = EmptyState(self.search_list_view, 'No search result.\nEnter a query above to search this workspace.')

        
        self.encoding_status = StatusItem('UTF-8', self._choose_document_encoding, self)
        self.eol_status = StatusItem('LF', self._choose_document_eol, self)
        self.indent_status = StatusItem('Spaces: 4', self._choose_document_indent, self)
        self.interpreter_status = StatusItem('Python', self.choose_interpreter, self)
        self.document_status = QLabel(self)
        for item in (self.encoding_status, self.eol_status, self.indent_status, self.interpreter_status, self.document_status):
            self.statusBar().addPermanentWidget(item)
        self._status_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._status_timer.timeout.connect(self._refresh_document_status)
        self._status_timer.start(250)
        
        density: str = self.settings.value('layout_density', 'comfortable', type=str)
        self._apply_density(density if density in {'compact', 'comfortable'} else 'comfortable')

        self.breadcrumbs = Breadcrumbs(self)
        self.breadcrumb_bar = QToolBar('Breadcrumbs', self)
        self.breadcrumbs.configure_toolbar(self.breadcrumb_bar)
        self.breadcrumb_bar.addWidget(self.breadcrumbs)
        # Give the path its own row if another top toolbar already exists.
        self.addToolBarBreak(Qt.TopToolBarArea)
        self.addToolBar(Qt.TopToolBarArea, self.breadcrumb_bar)
        self.breadcrumbs.directory_requested.connect(self._reveal_breadcrumb)
        self.breadcrumbs.line_requested.connect(self._jump_breadcrumb)
        self._breadcrumb_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._breadcrumb_timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self._breadcrumb_timer.setInterval(180)
        self._breadcrumb_timer.timeout.connect(self._refresh_breadcrumbs)
        self.tab_view.currentEditorChanged.connect(lambda *args: self._refresh_breadcrumbs())
        # Also catches Save As / rename without rewriting their save lifecycle.
        self._breadcrumb_path_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._breadcrumb_path_timer.timeout.connect(self._refresh_breadcrumbs)
        self._breadcrumb_path_timer.start(500)

        if hasattr(sys, "_MEIPASS"):
            # We're running as a bundled exe
            import os

            home = os.path.expanduser("~")
            self.file_manager.model.setRootPath(home)
            self.file_manager.setRootIndex(self.file_manager.model.index(home))
        # Reopen the tabs from the previous sessions (no-op when
        # the feature is disabled or nothing was saved)
        self._apply_settings(self._load_settings())
        if self._hacker:
            self._set_scanlines_visible(True)
        self.providers = ProviderBridge(self)
        self.spelling = SpellingProvider(self)
        self._restore_session()
````

**`MainWindow._restart_ruff`**

````python
    def _restart_ruff(
            self,
            python_executable: str | None = None,
            workspace_root: Path | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Replace the shared Ruff server after interpreter/workspace changes.

        Every open Python controller is reconnected to the new shared client.
        The old client then performs its asynchronous LSP shutdown. No editor
        owns a separate Ruff process.
        """
        executable = python_executable or self.python_runner.interpreter
        root = Path(workspace_root or self._workspace_root).resolve()
        self._workspace_root = root

        self.diagnostics_manager.clear_provider("ruff")
        self.references_panel.set_locations([])
        for view in self.tab_view.all_editors():
            if isinstance(view, PythonEditor):
                view.references_finder.invalidate()
        if getattr(self, "test_session", None) is not None:
            self.test_session.invalidate()
            self._test_context = None
        shared_analysis().invalidate_all()
        if hasattr(self, "providers"):
            self.providers.restart()
            self.spelling.reload()
        old_client = self.ruff_lsp_client
        client = RuffLspClient(
            python_executable=executable,
            workspace_root=root,
            parent=self,
        )
        client.server_error.connect(self._on_ruff_lsp_error)
        self.ruff_lsp_client = client

        for editor in self.tab_view.all_editors():
            if isinstance(editor, PythonEditor) and editor.ruff_lsp is not None:
                editor.ruff_lsp.set_client(client)

        old_client.shutdown()
        client.start()
````

**`MainWindow.closeEvent`**

````python
    def closeEvent(self, event: Any) -> Any:
        """Closeevent."""
        if getattr(self, "_close_ready", False):
            event.accept()
            return super().closeEvent(event)

        if not getattr(self, "_close_prompts_complete", False):
            # DirtyViews yields one representative per dirty document.
            for editor in list(self._dirty_editors):
                self.tab_view.focus_editor(editor)
                path = getattr(editor, "path", None)
                name = Path(path).name if path is not None else "Untitled"
                reply = QMessageBox.question(
                    self,
                    "Unsaved Changes",
                    f"Save changes to '{name}'?",
                    QMessageBox.Save | QMessageBox.Discard | QMessageBox.Cancel,
                    QMessageBox.Save,
                )
                if reply == QMessageBox.Cancel:
                    event.ignore()
                    return
                if reply == QMessageBox.Save and not self.save_file():
                    event.ignore()
                    return
            if self.recovery is not None:
                self.recovery.finish()
            self._close_prompts_complete = True
            self.save_session()

        for editor in list(self.tab_view.all_editors()):
            self.tab_view.remove_editor(editor)
            self._dispose_editor(editor)

        self.file_watcher.shutdown()
        process = getattr(self, '_comparison_process', None)
        if process is not None:
            process.kill()
        process = getattr(self, '_rename_process', None)
        if process is not None:
            process.kill()
        if getattr(self, "_symbol_job", None) is not None:
            self._symbol_job.requestInterruption()
        self.test_session.invalidate()
        self.profile_runner.stop()
        if getattr(self, "_hash_job", None) is not None:
            self._hash_job.requestInterruption()
        self.spelling.shutdown()
        self.analysis_queue.shutdown()
        if self.terminal is not None:
            self.terminal.stop()
        if hasattr(self.python_runner, "shutdown"):
            self.python_runner.shutdown()
        else:
            # Compatibility until Fix 5 replaces PythonRunner.
            self.python_runner.stop()
        self.providers.shutdown()
        for client in self._retired_type_clients:
            client.shutdown()
        self.ruff_lsp_client.shutdown()
        if hasattr(self.search_worker, "shutdown"):
            self.search_worker.shutdown()
        self.settings.setValue("recent_files", self.recent_files)
        
        self.file_manager.git_checker.shutdown()
        self.git_service.shutdown()

        if self._background_work_running():
            event.ignore()
            QTimer.singleShot(100, self._finish_pending_close)
            return

        self._close_ready = True
        event.accept()
        super().closeEvent(event)
````

#### `ruff_implementation/spelling.py` — new module

Read the complete target file below. Section 3 specifies its installation; do not install a second copy.

````python
"""Local English/German spelling with immutable work and bounded result counts."""
from __future__ import annotations

import builtins
import hashlib
import io
import keyword
import re
import tokenize
from functools import lru_cache
from pathlib import Path
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any
from PyQt5.QtCore import QObject, QTimer
from spellchecker import SpellChecker
from code_inteligence.analysis_key import RequestKey
from code_inteligence.analysis_scheduler import shared_analysis
from ruff_implementation.diagnostics_model import Diagnostic, DiagnosticSeverity, Position, SourceRange

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from main import MainWindow

WORD = re.compile(r"[^\W\d_]+", re.UNICODE)
CAMEL = re.compile(r"[A-ZÄÖÜ]+(?=[A-ZÄÖÜ][a-zäöüß]|$)|[A-ZÄÖÜ]?[a-zäöüß]+")


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def dictionary() -> SpellChecker:
    """Load bundled dictionaries once inside the serialized analysis worker."""
    return SpellChecker(language=["en", "de"], distance=1)


def check_words(source: str, allow: frozenset[str]) -> tuple[tuple[int, int, int, str], ...]:
    """Inspect names, strings, docstrings and comments without modifying source."""
    spell = dictionary()
    ignored: frozenset[str] = allow | frozenset(keyword.kwlist) | frozenset(dir(builtins))
    results: list[tuple[int, int, int, str]] = []
    try:
        tokens = tokenize.generate_tokens(io.StringIO(source).readline)
        for token in tokens:
            if token.type not in {tokenize.NAME, tokenize.COMMENT, tokenize.STRING}:
                continue
            if token.string.casefold() in ignored:
                continue
            for row_offset, row in enumerate(token.string.splitlines()):
                base: int = token.start[1] if row_offset == 0 else 0
                for word in WORD.finditer(row):
                    pieces = list(CAMEL.finditer(word.group())) if token.type == tokenize.NAME else []
                    spans = [(word.start() + part.start(), part.group()) for part in pieces] or [(word.start(), word.group())]
                    for start, value in spans:
                        normalized: str = value.casefold()
                        if len(normalized) < 3 or normalized in ignored or normalized in spell:
                            continue
                        results.append((token.start[0] - 1 + row_offset, base + start,
                                        base + start + len(value), value))
                        if len(results) >= 500:
                            return tuple(results)
    except (tokenize.TokenError, IndentationError, SyntaxError):
        # Keep findings before an incomplete string or unfinished statement.
        pass
    return tuple(results)


class SpellingProvider(QObject):
    """Schedule only changed documents and discard results from older workspaces."""

    def __init__(self, window: MainWindow) -> None:
        """Share the application queue; do not create another worker pool."""
        super().__init__(window)
        self.window = window
        self.queue = shared_analysis()
        self.queue.ready.connect(self.receive)
        self.keys: dict[str, RequestKey] = {}
        self.allow: frozenset[str] = frozenset()
        self.closed: bool = False
        self.timer = QTimer(self)
        self.timer.setInterval(800)
        self.timer.timeout.connect(self.sync)
        self.reload()
        self.timer.start()

    def reload(self) -> None:
        """Read an optional project dictionary, one accepted word per line."""
        for uri in self.keys:
            self.queue.cancel(uri, "spelling")
        self.keys.clear()
        path: Path = self.window._workspace_root / ".markdowneditor-spelling.txt"
        try:
            if path.is_file() and path.stat().st_size <= 1_000_000:
                self.allow = frozenset(line.strip().casefold() for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
                                       if line.strip() and not line.startswith("#"))
            else:
                self.allow = frozenset()
        except (OSError, UnicodeError) as error:
            self.window.statusBar().showMessage(f"Spelling dictionary: {error}", 6000)

    def sync(self) -> None:
        """Snapshot Python buffers on the GUI thread and submit bounded work."""
        if self.closed:
            return
        live: set[str] = set()
        for document in self.window.documents.all():
            editor = document.analysis_owner
            controller = getattr(editor, "ruff_lsp", None)
            if controller is None or getattr(editor, "large_file_mode", False):
                continue
            uri: str = controller.uri
            live.add(uri)
            previous = self.keys.get(uri)
            if previous is not None and previous.revision == controller.document_version:
                continue
            source: str = editor.text()
            key = RequestKey(str(editor.path or ""), controller.document_version,
                             self.window.python_runner.interpreter, str(self.window._workspace_root),
                             "spelling", uri, source_hash=hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest())
            self.keys[uri] = key
            allow: frozenset[str] = self.allow
            self.queue.submit(key, lambda source=source, allow=allow: check_words(source, allow))
        for uri in self.keys.keys() - live:
            self.queue.cancel(uri, "spelling")
            self.keys.pop(uri, None)

    def receive(self, key: RequestKey, value: Any) -> None:
        """Publish only if both source revision and provider key remain current."""
        if self.closed or key.kind != "spelling" or self.keys.get(key.document) != key:
            return
        controller = self.window.providers.current.get(key.document)
        if controller is None or controller.document_version != key.revision:
            return
        if isinstance(value, Exception):
            self.window.statusBar().showMessage(f"Spelling: {value}", 5000)
            return
        rows: list[Diagnostic] = [Diagnostic("spelling", key.document, controller.editor.path,
            SourceRange(Position(line, start), Position(line, end)), DiagnosticSeverity.INFORMATION,
            "spelling", f"Unknown English/German word: {word}", key.revision)
            for line, start, end, word in value]
        self.window.diagnostics_manager.replace("spelling", key.document, rows)

    def shutdown(self) -> None:
        """Cancel pending results; running immutable work remains queue-owned."""
        self.closed = True
        self.timer.stop()
        for uri in self.keys:
            self.queue.cancel(uri, "spelling")
        self.keys.clear()
````

````python
    def _restart_ruff(
            self,
            python_executable: str | None = None,
            workspace_root: Path | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Replace the shared Ruff server after interpreter/workspace changes.

        Every open Python controller is reconnected to the new shared client.
        The old client then performs its asynchronous LSP shutdown. No editor
        owns a separate Ruff process.
        """
        executable = python_executable or self.python_runner.interpreter
        root = Path(workspace_root or self._workspace_root).resolve()
        self._workspace_root = root

        self.diagnostics_manager.clear_provider("ruff")
        self.references_panel.set_locations([])
        for view in self.tab_view.all_editors():
            if isinstance(view, PythonEditor):
                view.references_finder.invalidate()
        if getattr(self, "test_session", None) is not None:
            self.test_session.invalidate()
            self._test_context = None
        shared_analysis().invalidate_all()
        if hasattr(self, "providers"):
            self.providers.restart()
            self.spelling.reload()
        old_client = self.ruff_lsp_client
        client = RuffLspClient(
            python_executable=executable,
            workspace_root=root,
            parent=self,
        )
        client.server_error.connect(self._on_ruff_lsp_error)
        self.ruff_lsp_client = client

        for editor in self.tab_view.all_editors():
            if isinstance(editor, PythonEditor) and editor.ruff_lsp is not None:
                editor.ruff_lsp.set_client(client)

        old_client.shutdown()
        client.start()

    def _on_editor_cursor_changed(self, editor, line: int, column: int):
        """Update the status bar only for the focused editor."""
````

<a id="topic-48"></a>

## Topic 48: Retain diagnostic underlines during pending analysis

### 1. Topic explanation

Keep existing indicator paint while new analysis is pending, but immediately invalidate hover/action ranges tied to the old revision. Only a current successful snapshot, including an empty snapshot, replaces that provider’s paint. Use UTF-8 byte offsets for indicator operations, and reject stale Problems navigation. Different providers own disjoint indicator IDs.

**Current implementation:** Partially implemented; completed and improved here.

**Prerequisites:** Topic 04, Topic 43, Topic 44. Keep all preceding cumulative changes.

**Documentation used:**

- [Scintilla editing, markers, indicators and folding](https://www.scintilla.org/ScintillaDoc.html)
- [Language Server Protocol 3.17](https://microsoft.github.io/language-server-protocol/specifications/lsp/3.17/specification/)

### 2. Topic code

#### `main.py` — updated existing module

The complete changed functions/methods are shown below. Keep them in their named existing classes. Imports and other module-level changes are shown at their exact locations in section 3.

**`MainWindow._open_problem`**

````python
    def _open_problem(self, diagnostic: Any) -> None:
        """Navigate to a live URI owner, including an unsaved Python document."""
        point = diagnostic.source_range.start
        for editor in self.tab_view.all_editors():
            controller = getattr(editor, "ruff_lsp", None)
            if controller is not None and controller.uri == diagnostic.uri:
                if diagnostic.revision != controller.document_version:
                    self.statusBar().showMessage("Analysis pending; this location is stale.", 3000)
                    return
                self.tab_view.focus_editor(editor)
                editor.setCursorPosition(point.line, point.column)
                return
        if diagnostic.path is not None:
            self._open_file_at_position(str(diagnostic.path), point.line, point.column)
````

````python
    def mouseMoveEvent(self, e: QMouseEvent) -> None:
        """Update diagnostic hover without requesting or hiding documentation."""
        if self.is_python_file and not self._shutting_down:
            self._last_mouse_pos = e.pos()
            self._ruff_hover_timer.start()
        super().mouseMoveEvent(e)
````

````python
class RuffDiagnosticView:
    """
    Paint exact Ruff ranges, gutter markers, hover cards and fix markers.
    
    This class owns only new Ruff visual IDs. 
    It never reads or clears old pyflakes indicator IDs, so migration cannot accidentally mix systems.
    """
    
    ERROR_INDICATOR = 20
    WARNING_INDICATOR = 21
    INFO_INDICATOR = 22
    FIX_INDICATOR = 23
    ERROR_MARKER = 20
    WARNING_MARKER = 21
    INFO_MARKER = 22
    FIX_MARKER = 23
    
    def __init__(self, editor: QsciScintilla):
        """Define a completely independent Ruff colour and marker palette."""
        self.editor = editor
        self.by_line: dict[int, list[RuffDiagnostic]] = {}
        self._define_visuals()
        
    def _define_visuals(self):
        """Reserve QScintilla IDs and assign visible Ruff colors/styles."""
        
        # Indicators paint text ranges in the editor body. They are independent of marker
        # IDs, which paint optional symbols in a seperate gutter margin.
        self.editor.indicatorDefine(QsciScintilla.SquiggleIndicator, self.ERROR_INDICATOR)
        self.editor.setIndicatorForegroundColor(QColor("#ff5c57"), self.ERROR_INDICATOR)
        
        self.editor.indicatorDefine(QsciScintilla.SquiggleIndicator, self.WARNING_INDICATOR)
        self.editor.setIndicatorForegroundColor(QColor("#ffbd2e"), self.WARNING_INDICATOR)
        
        # Use a blue squiggle rather than DotBotIndicator. A DotBox is to subtle against the current dark theme
        # and made information/hint diagnostics look as if they were missing.
        self.editor.indicatorDefine(QsciScintilla.SquiggleIndicator, self.INFO_INDICATOR)
        self.editor.setIndicatorForegroundColor(QColor("#55aaff"), self.INFO_INDICATOR)
        
        # FIX_INDICATOR is visually distinct because it marks diagnostics for which 
        # the later codeAction implementation can offer an automatic resolution.
        self.editor.indicatorDefine(QsciScintilla.RoundBoxIndicator, self.FIX_INDICATOR)
        self.editor.setIndicatorForegroundColor(QColor("#a6e22e"), self.FIX_INDICATOR)
        
        # Marker IDs are seperate from indicator IDs even when numerical values happen to
        # be the same. Markers require a QScintilla SymbolMargin to show.
        for marker, color in (
            (self.ERROR_MARKER, "#ff5c57"),
            (self.WARNING_MARKER, "#ffbd2e"),
            (self.INFO_MARKER, "#55aaff"),
            (self.FIX_MARKER, "#a6e22e"),
        ):
            self.editor.markerDefine(QsciScintilla.Circle, marker)
            self.editor.setMarkerForegroundColor(QColor(color), marker)
            self.editor.setMarkerBackgroundColor(QColor(color), marker)
    
    def clear(self) -> None:
        """Clear only this provider's indicators using exact document byte length."""
        length: int = int(self.editor.SendScintilla(2006))
        for indicator in {self.ERROR_INDICATOR, self.WARNING_INDICATOR, self.INFO_INDICATOR, self.FIX_INDICATOR}:
            self.editor.SendScintilla(2500, indicator)
            self.editor.SendScintilla(2505, 0, length)
        for marker in {self.ERROR_MARKER, self.WARNING_MARKER, self.INFO_MARKER, self.FIX_MARKER}:
            self.editor.markerDeleteAll(marker)
        self.by_line.clear()
    
    def render(self, diagnostics: list[RuffDiagnostic]) -> None:
        """Paint one complete provider snapshot without affecting any other provider."""
        self.clear()
        length: int = int(self.editor.SendScintilla(2006))
        for diagnostic in diagnostics:
            start: int = self._byte_position(diagnostic.start.line, diagnostic.start.column)
            end: int = self._byte_position(diagnostic.end.line, diagnostic.end.column)
            indicator: int = {RuffSeverity.ERROR: self.ERROR_INDICATOR,
                RuffSeverity.WARNING: self.WARNING_INDICATOR, RuffSeverity.INFO: self.INFO_INDICATOR}[diagnostic.severity]
            if end <= start and start < length:
                end = int(self.editor.SendScintilla(2418, start))  # SCI_POSITIONAFTER
            if end > start:
                self.editor.SendScintilla(2500, indicator)
                self.editor.SendScintilla(2504, start, end - start)
            marker: int = {RuffSeverity.ERROR: self.ERROR_MARKER,
                RuffSeverity.WARNING: self.WARNING_MARKER, RuffSeverity.INFO: self.INFO_MARKER}[diagnostic.severity]
            self.editor.markerAdd(diagnostic.start.line, marker)
            self.by_line.setdefault(diagnostic.start.line, []).append(diagnostic)

    def at_line(self, line: int) -> RuffDiagnostic | None:
        """Return highest severity diagnostic on one line for hover/menu use."""
        items = self.by_line.get(line, [])
        return min(items, key=lambda item: item.severity) if items else None

    def tooltip(self, diagnostic: RuffDiagnostic) -> str:
        """Build a new Ruff-only hover card; no Jedi pyflakes content."""
        fix_line = "\nQuick fix available: right-click the diagnostic." if diagnostic.fix else ""
        return f"{diagnostic.code} - {diagnostic.message}{fix_line}"
    def _byte_position(self, line: int, column: int) -> int:
        """Convert character columns to UTF-8 byte positions used by Scintilla."""
        line = min(max(line, 0), max(0, self.editor.lines() - 1))
        text: str = self.editor.text(line).rstrip("\r\n")
        return int(self.editor.SendScintilla(2167, line)) + len(text[:max(0, column)].encode("utf-8"))
````

````python
"""Bridge one PythonEditor document to the shared Ruff languafe server."""

from __future__ import annotations
from typing import Any
from PyQt5.QtCore import QPoint
from PyQt5.QtWidgets import QMenu, QMessageBox
from ruff_implementation.workspace_edit import WorkspaceEditApplier, WorkspaceEditError


from pathlib import Path
from uuid import uuid4

from PyQt5.QtCore import QObject, QTimer, pyqtSignal
from PyQt5.QtWidgets import QToolTip

from ruff_implementation.ruff_diagnostics_model import RuffDiagnostic, RuffPosition, RuffSeverity
from ruff_implementation.ruff_diagnostics_view import RuffDiagnosticView

class RuffLspController(QObject):
    """Keep one QScintilla Python document synchronized with Ruff LSP."""
    diagnostics_changed = pyqtSignal(object, list)
    
    def __init__(self, editor, client, parent=None):
        # Parent this controller to the editor unless a different explicit parent was supplied.
        # Destroying the tab then also destroys its controller.
        super().__init__(parent or editor)

        self.editor = editor
        self.client = client
        self._uri = self._uri_for_path(editor.full_path)
        
        # Reuse the existing visual layer. It remains responsible only for QScintilla
        # indicators, marker circles, tooltips and range caching.
        self.view = RuffDiagnosticView(editor)
        
        # LSP versions begin at an integer and must increase for every didChange.
        self.document_version = 1
        
        # didOpen must be sent exactly once per URI/server lifecycle.
        self._opened = False
        self._closed = False
        
        # Full-buffer updates are delayed slightly while a user is typing.
        # This prevents sending one didChange messafe for every individual keypress.
        self.change_timer = QTimer(self)
        self.change_timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self.change_timer.setInterval(180)
        self.change_timer.timeout.connect(self._send_change)
        
        # QScintilla emits textChanged for user input, pasted text, fixes, etc.
        editor.textChanged.connect(self._on_text_changed)
        
        # If Ruff is still starting when this tab is constructed, open_document
        # wil run as soon as initialize/initialized completes.
        client.server_ready.connect(self.open_document)
        client.server_stopped.connect(self._on_server_stopped)

        client.diagnostics_published.connect(self._on_diagnostics_published)
        if client.is_ready:
            self.open_document()
    
    @property
    def uri(self) -> str:
        """Return the stable LSP URI identifying this document to Ruff."""
        return self._uri

    @staticmethod
    def _uri_for_path(path) -> str:
        if path is None:
            path = Path.cwd() / f"untitled-{uuid4().hex}.py"
        return Path(path).resolve().as_uri()

    def _on_server_stopped(self):
        self._opened = False

    def relocate(self, path: Any) -> None:
        """Migrate this open buffer to a new URI after Save As or rename."""
        self._clear_problem_rows()
        old_uri = self._uri
        if self._opened and self.client.is_ready:
            self.client.close_document(old_uri)
        self._uri = self._uri_for_path(path)
        self._opened = False
        self.document_version += 1
        self.open_document()

    def set_client(self, client):
        """Reconnect this document when the selected Ruff interpreter changes."""
        try:
            self.client.server_ready.disconnect(self.open_document)
            self.client.server_stopped.disconnect(self._on_server_stopped)
            self.client.diagnostics_published.disconnect(self._on_diagnostics_published)
        except TypeError:
            pass
        self.client = client
        self._opened = False
        client.server_ready.connect(self.open_document)
        client.server_stopped.connect(self._on_server_stopped)
        client.diagnostics_published.connect(self._on_diagnostics_published)
        if client.is_ready:
            self.open_document()
        
    def open_document(self) -> None:
        """Send didOpen once after the shared server is ready."""
        if getattr(self.editor, "large_file_mode", False):
            return
        """Send didOpen once after the shared server is ready."""
        if self._closed or self._opened or not self.client.is_ready:
            return
        
        self.client.open_document(
            self.uri,
            self.editor.text(),
            self.document_version,
        )
        self._opened = True
        
    def sync_from_editor(self) -> None:
        """Syncronize editor text after programmatic loading with blocked signals."""
        if getattr(self.editor, "large_file_mode", False):
            return
        """Syncronize editor text after programmatic loading with blocked signals."""
        if self._closed:
            return
            
        # setTextSafely() blocks editor.textChanged while loading a disk file.
        # Therefore this method manually creates a new LSP document version for the newly loaded source text.
        self.document_version += 1
        
        if not self._opened:
            # Ruff may still be starting. If it is ready, this sends didOpen with the current loaded text.
            # If it is not ready yet, the existing server_ready -> open_document signal connection will do so later.
            self.open_document()
            return
        
        if not self.client.is_ready:
            return
            
        # The Ruff server already knows this document, but perbiously recieved the empty editor text during 
        # PythonEditor construction. Replace it immediately with the actual source read from disk.
        self.client.change_document(self.uri, self.editor.text(), self.document_version)
    
    def _on_text_changed(self) -> None:
        """Advance document version and schedule one debounced didChange."""
        if getattr(self.editor, "large_file_mode", False):
            return
        """Advance document version and schedule one debounced didChange."""
        self.view.by_line.clear()
        for view in getattr(self.editor, "_provider_views", {}).values():
            view.by_line.clear()
        if self._closed:
            return
        
        # Each text state must have a stricly newer version that the last.
        self.document_version += 1
        
        # Normally MainWindow starts Ruff before editors are made. This fallback
        # makes the controller safe if a tab is created during server startup.
        if not self._opened:
            self.open_document()
        
        if self._opened:
            # Calling start() again on s single-shot timer resets its countdown.
            # One change is sent only after typing has been idle for 180 ms.
            self.change_timer.start()

    def _send_change(self) -> None:
        """Transmit the current complete QScintilla text buffer to Ruff."""
        if getattr(self.editor, "large_file_mode", False):
            return
        """Transmit the current complete QScintilla text buffer to Ruff."""
        if self._closed or not self._opened or not self.client.is_ready:
            return

        self.client.change_document(
            self.uri,
            self.editor.text(),
            self.document_version,
        )

    def _lsp_column_to_character(self, line: int, column: int) -> int:
        """Translate negotiated LSP units into QScintilla character columns."""
        if line < 0 or line >= self.editor.lines():
            return 0
        value = self.editor.text(line).rstrip("\r\n")
        column = max(0, int(column))
        encoding = getattr(self.client, "position_encoding", "utf-16")
        if encoding == "utf-8":
            raw = value.encode("utf-8")[:column]
            return len(raw.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore"))
        if encoding == "utf-16":
            raw = value.encode("utf-16-le")[: column * 2]
            return len(raw.decode("utf-16-le", errors="ignore"))
        return min(column, len(value))

    def _on_diagnostics_published(self, uri: str, raw_diagnostics: Any, version: Any) -> None:
        """Render only current diagnostics belonging to this document."""
        if self._closed or uri != self.uri:
            return
        if version is None or version != self.document_version:
            return

        diagnostics = [self._to_diagnostic(raw) for raw in raw_diagnostics]
        self.view.render(diagnostics)
        # MainWindow owns the cat/XP state; the controller only reports data.
        self.diagnostics_changed.emit(self.editor, diagnostics)

    def _to_diagnostic(self, raw: dict) -> RuffDiagnostic:
        """Convert one LSP diagnostic, including negotiated column units."""
        raw_range = raw.get("range") or {}
        start = raw_range.get("start") or {}
        end = raw_range.get("end") or start
        start_line = max(0, int(start.get("line", 0)))
        last_line = max(0, self.editor.lines() - 1)
        start_line = min(start_line, last_line)
        end_line = min(last_line, max(start_line, int(end.get("line", start_line))))

        severity_by_number = {
            1: RuffSeverity.ERROR,
            2: RuffSeverity.WARNING,
            3: RuffSeverity.INFO,
            4: RuffSeverity.INFO,
        }
        code = raw.get("code", "Ruff")
        if not isinstance(code, str):
            code = str(code)

        return RuffDiagnostic(
            code=code,
            message=str(raw.get("message", "Ruff diagnostic")),
            severity=severity_by_number.get(raw.get("severity"), RuffSeverity.WARNING),
            start=RuffPosition(
                start_line,
                self._lsp_column_to_character(start_line, start.get("character", 0)),
            ),
            end=RuffPosition(
                end_line,
                self._lsp_column_to_character(end_line, end.get("character", 0)),
            ),
            revision=self.document_version,
            raw=raw,
        )

    def hover(self, position: Any) -> bool:
        """Show a short diagnostic tooltip for the current line, if any."""
        # SCI_POSITIONFROMPOINT (2022) returns a Scintilla byte position at the
        # mouse coordinate. -1 means the pointer is outside text content.
        byte_position = self.editor.SendScintilla(
            2022,
            position.x(),
            position.y(),
        )
        if byte_position < 0:
            QToolTip.hideText()
            return False

        # Convert byte position to a zero-based line number. UTF-8 decode with
        # errors=ignore handles a pointer position inside a multi-byte character.
        prefix = self.editor.text().encode("utf-8")[:byte_position].decode(
            "utf-8",
            errors="ignore",
        )
        line: int = prefix.count("\n")
        views = [self.view, *getattr(self.editor, "_provider_views", {}).values()]
        candidates = [item for view in views if (item := view.at_line(line)) is not None]
        diagnostic = min(candidates, key=lambda item: item.severity) if candidates else None

        if diagnostic:
            QToolTip.showText(
                self.editor.mapToGlobal(position),
                self.view.tooltip(diagnostic),
                self.editor,
            )
            return True

        QToolTip.hideText()
        return False

    def context_menu(self, event: Any, view: Any=None) -> bool | None:
        """Display current Ruff quick fixes without retaining the temporary Qt event."""
        view = view or self.editor
        position = view.SendScintilla(view.SCI_POSITIONFROMPOINT, event.pos().x(), event.pos().y())
        if position < 0:
            return False
        line, _column = self.editor.lineIndexFromPosition(position)
        diagnostic = self.view.at_line(line)
        if diagnostic is None:
            return False
        point = QPoint(event.globalPos())
        def receive(actions: Any, error: Any, uri: Any, revision: Any) -> None:
            """Show returned action titles and apply only the explicitly selected item."""
            if error:
                QMessageBox.warning(self.editor, "Quick fixes", str(error))
                return
            menu = QMenu(self.editor)
            pairs = []
            for action in actions:
                if not isinstance(action, dict):
                    continue
                item = menu.addAction(str(action.get("title", "Quick fix")))
                item.setEnabled(not bool(action.get("disabled")))
                pairs.append((item, action))
            if not pairs:
                menu.addAction("No quick fix available").setEnabled(False)
            chosen = menu.exec_(point)
            for item, action in pairs:
                if chosen is item:
                    try:
                        self.apply_code_action(action, uri, revision)
                    except WorkspaceEditError as error:
                        QMessageBox.warning(self.editor, "Quick fixes", str(error))
                    break
        self.request_quick_fixes(diagnostic, receive)
        return True

    def shutdown(self) -> None:
        """Stop synchronization, tell Ruff the tab is closed, clear visuals."""
        self._clear_problem_rows()
        if self._closed:
            return
        self._closed = True
        self.change_timer.stop()
        # didClose is sent only after didOpen; otherwise the server has never
        # heard about this document and closing it would be meaningless.
        if self._opened:
            self.client.close_document(self.uri)
        try:
            self.client.server_ready.disconnect(self.open_document)
            self.client.server_stopped.disconnect(self._on_server_stopped)
            self.client.diagnostics_published.disconnect(self._on_diagnostics_published)
        except TypeError:
            pass
        self.view.clear()

    def _clear_problem_rows(self) -> None:
        """Remove this URI's Problems rows when its text or lifecycle changes."""
        manager = getattr(self.editor.window(), "diagnostics_manager", None)
        if manager is not None:
            manager.replace("ruff", self.uri, [])

    def request_quick_fixes(self, diagnostic: Any, callback: Any) -> None:
        """Request actions with raw provider data and capture the exact document identity."""
        uri, revision, client = self.uri, self.document_version, self.client
        if self._closed or diagnostic.revision != revision or not client.is_ready:
            callback([], {"message": "Diagnostic is stale"}, uri, revision)
            return
        self.change_timer.stop()
        self._send_change()
        def receive(result: Any, error: Any) -> None:
            """Discard replies after closure, relocation, editing or server replacement."""
            if self._closed or client is not self.client or self.uri != uri or self.document_version != revision:
                return
            callback(result if isinstance(result, list) else [], error, uri, revision)
        client.request("textDocument/codeAction", {
            "textDocument": {"uri": uri}, "range": diagnostic.raw["range"],
            "context": {"diagnostics": [diagnostic.raw], "only": ["quickfix"], "triggerKind": 1}}, receive)

    def apply_code_action(self, action: Any, uri: Any, revision: Any) -> None:
        """Apply a direct edit completely or report an unsupported action form."""
        if action.get("disabled") or action.get("command") or not isinstance(action.get("edit"), dict):
            raise WorkspaceEditError("This action needs an unsupported command or resolve step")
        WorkspaceEditApplier(self).apply(action["edit"], uri, revision)
````

````python
        for marker in {self.ERROR_MARKER, self.WARNING_MARKER, self.INFO_MARKER, self.FIX_MARKER}:
            self.editor.markerDeleteAll(marker)
        self.by_line.clear()
    
    def render(self, diagnostics: list[RuffDiagnostic]) -> None:
        """Paint one complete provider snapshot without affecting any other provider."""
        self.clear()
        length: int = int(self.editor.SendScintilla(2006))
        for diagnostic in diagnostics:
            start: int = self._byte_position(diagnostic.start.line, diagnostic.start.column)
            end: int = self._byte_position(diagnostic.end.line, diagnostic.end.column)
            indicator: int = {RuffSeverity.ERROR: self.ERROR_INDICATOR,
                RuffSeverity.WARNING: self.WARNING_INDICATOR, RuffSeverity.INFO: self.INFO_INDICATOR}[diagnostic.severity]
            if end <= start and start < length:
                end = int(self.editor.SendScintilla(2418, start))  # SCI_POSITIONAFTER
            if end > start:
                self.editor.SendScintilla(2500, indicator)
                self.editor.SendScintilla(2504, start, end - start)
            marker: int = {RuffSeverity.ERROR: self.ERROR_MARKER,
                RuffSeverity.WARNING: self.WARNING_MARKER, RuffSeverity.INFO: self.INFO_MARKER}[diagnostic.severity]
            self.editor.markerAdd(diagnostic.start.line, marker)
            self.by_line.setdefault(diagnostic.start.line, []).append(diagnostic)

    def at_line(self, line: int) -> RuffDiagnostic | None:
        """Return highest severity diagnostic on one line for hover/menu use."""
        items = self.by_line.get(line, [])
        return min(items, key=lambda item: item.severity) if items else None

    def tooltip(self, diagnostic: RuffDiagnostic) -> str:
        """Build a new Ruff-only hover card; no Jedi pyflakes content."""
        fix_line = "\nQuick fix available: right-click the diagnostic." if diagnostic.fix else ""
        return f"{diagnostic.code} - {diagnostic.message}{fix_line}"
    def _byte_position(self, line: int, column: int) -> int:
        """Convert character columns to UTF-8 byte positions used by Scintilla."""
        line = min(max(line, 0), max(0, self.editor.lines() - 1))
        text: str = self.editor.text(line).rstrip("\r\n")
        return int(self.editor.SendScintilla(2167, line)) + len(text[:max(0, column)].encode("utf-8"))
````
